codeset.name: GroupMembershipBasis
codeset.description: Basis for membership in a group

code.name: Definitional
code.description: The Group.characteristics specified are both necessary and sufficient to determine membership. All entities that meet the criteria are considered to be members of the group, whether referenced by the group or not. If members are present, they are individuals that happen to be known as meeting the Group.characteristics. The list cannot be presumed to be complete.

code.name: Enumerated
code.description: The Group.characteristics are necessary but not sufficient to determine membership. Membership is determined by being listed as one of the Group.member.

operation.name: everything
operation.description: This operation is used to return all the information related to one or more patients that are part of the group on which this operation is invoked. The response is a bundle of type "searchset". At a minimum, the patient resource(s) itself is returned, along with any other resources that the server has that are related to the patient(s), and that are available for the given user. The server also returns whatever resources are needed to support the records - e.g. linked practitioners, medications, locations, organizations etc. The intended use for this operation is for a provider or other user to perform a bulk data download. The server SHOULD return at least all resources that it has that are in the patient compartment for the identified patient(s), and any resource referenced from those, including binaries and attachments. In the US Realm, at a mimimum, the resources returned SHALL include all the data covered by the meaningful use common data elements as defined in [US-Core](http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core). Other applicable implementation guides may make additional rules about how much information that is returned.

parameter.name: start
parameter.description: The date range relates to care dates, not record currency dates - e.g. all records relating to care provided in a certain date range. If no start date is provided, all records prior to the end date are in scope.

parameter.name: end
parameter.description: The date range relates to care dates, not record currency dates - e.g. all records relating to care provided in a certain date range. If no end date is provided, all records subsequent to the start date are in scope.

parameter.name: _since
parameter.description: Resources updated after this period will be included in the response. The intent of this parameter is to allow a client to request only records that have changed since the last request, based on either the return header time, or or (for asynchronous use), the transaction time

parameter.name: _type
parameter.description: One or more parameters, each containing one or more comma-delimited FHIR resource types to include in the return resources. In the absense of any specified types, the server returns all resource types

parameter.name: _count
parameter.description: See discussion below on the utility of paging through the results of the $everything operation

parameter.name: return
parameter.description: The bundle type is "searchset"

resource.name: GuidanceResponse
resource.description: A guidance response is the formal response to a guidance request, including any output parameters returned by the evaluation, as well as the description of any proposed actions to be taken.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: requestIdentifier
property.description: The identifier of the request associated with this response. If an identifier was given as part of the request, it will be reproduced here to enable the requester to more easily identify the response in a multi-request scenario.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Allows a service to provide unique, business identifiers for the response.

property.name: module
property.description: An identifier, CodeableConcept or canonical reference to the guidance that was requested.

property.name: status
property.description: The status of the response. If the evaluation is completed successfully, the status will indicate success. However, in order to complete the evaluation, the engine may require more information. In this case, the status will be data-required, and the response will contain a description of the additional required information. If the evaluation completed successfully, but the engine determines that a potentially more accurate response could be provided if more data was available, the status will be data-requested, and the response will contain a description of the additional requested information.

property.name: subject
property.description: The patient for which the request was processed.

property.name: encounter
property.description: The encounter during which this response was created or to which the creation of this record is tightly associated.

property.name: occurrenceDateTime
property.description: Indicates when the guidance response was processed.

property.name: performer
property.description: Provides a reference to the device that performed the guidance.

property.name: reason
property.description: Describes the reason for the guidance response in coded or textual form, or Indicates the reason the request was initiated. This is typically provided as a parameter to the evaluation and echoed by the service, although for some use cases, such as subscription- or event-based scenarios, it may provide an indication of the cause for the response.

property.name: note
property.description: Provides a mechanism to communicate additional information about the response.

property.name: evaluationMessage
property.description: Messages resulting from the evaluation of the artifact or artifacts. As part of evaluating the request, the engine may produce informational or warning messages. These messages will be provided by this element.

property.name: outputParameters
property.description: The output parameters of the evaluation, if any. Many modules will result in the return of specific resources such as procedure or communication requests that are returned as part of the operation result. However, modules may define specific outputs that would be returned as the result of the evaluation, and these would be returned in this element.

property.name: result
property.description: The actions, if any, produced by the evaluation of the artifact.

property.name: dataRequirement
property.description: If the evaluation could not be completed due to lack of information, or additional information would potentially result in a more accurate response, this element will a description of the data required in order to proceed with the evaluation. A subsequent request to the service should include this data.

codeset.name: GuidanceResponseStatus
codeset.description: The status of a guidance response.

code.name: Success
code.description: The request was processed successfully.

code.name: DataRequested
code.description: The request was processed successfully, but more data may result in a more complete evaluation.

code.name: DataRequired
code.description: The request was processed, but more data is required to complete the evaluation.

code.name: InProgress
code.description: The request is currently being processed.

code.name: Failure
code.description: The request was not processed successfully.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The response was entered in error.

property.description: This flag is used to mark the record to not be used. This is not used when a center is closed for maintenance, or for holidays, the notAvailable period is to be used for this.

property.name: providedBy

property.name: offeredIn
property.description: When the HealthcareService is representing a specific, schedulable service, the availableIn property can refer to a generic service.

property.name: category

property.name: type
property.description: The specific type of service that may be delivered or performed.

property.name: specialty
property.description: Collection of specialties handled by the Healthcare service. This is more of a medical term.

property.name: location
property.description: The location(s) where this healthcare service may be provided.

property.name: name
property.description: Further description of the service as it would be presented to a consumer while searching.

property.name: comment
property.description: Any additional description of the service and/or any specific issues not covered by the other attributes, which can be displayed as further detail under the serviceName.

property.name: extraDetails
property.description: Extra details about the service that cant be placed in the other fields.

property.name: photo
property.description: If there is a photo/symbol associated with this HealthcareService, it may be included here to facilitate quick identification of the service in a list.

property.name: contact
property.description: The contact details of communication devices available relevant to the specific HealthcareService. This can include addresses, phone numbers, fax numbers, mobile numbers, email addresses and web sites.

property.name: coverageArea
property.description: The location(s) that this service is available to (not where the service is provided).

property.name: serviceProvisionCode
property.description: The code(s) that detail the conditions under which the healthcare service is available/offered.

property.name: eligibility
property.description: Does this service have specific eligibility requirements that need to be met in order to use the service?

property.name: program
property.description: Programs that this service is applicable to.

property.name: characteristic
property.description: Collection of characteristics (attributes).

property.name: communication
property.description: Some services are specifically made available in multiple languages, this property permits a directory to declare the languages this is offered in. Typically this is only provided where a service operates in communities with mixed languages used.

property.name: referralMethod
property.description: Ways that the service accepts referrals, if this is not provided then it is implied that no referral is required.

property.name: appointmentRequired
property.description: Indicates whether or not a prospective consumer will require an appointment for a particular service at a site to be provided by the Organization. Indicates if an appointment is required for access to this service.

property.name: availability
property.description: A collection of times that the healthcare service is available.

property.name: endpoint
property.description: Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the specific healthcare services defined at this resource.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: code
property.description: Coded value for the eligibility.

property.name: comment
property.description: Describes the eligibility conditions for the service.

resource.name: ImagingSelection
resource.description: A selection of DICOM SOP instances and/or frames within a single Study and Series. This might include additional specifics such as an image region, an Observation UID or a Segmentation Number, allowing linkage to an Observation Resource or transferring this information along with the ImagingStudy Resource.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: A unique identifier assigned to this imaging selection.

property.name: status
property.description: The current state of the ImagingSelection resource. This is not the status of any ImagingStudy, ServiceRequest, or Task resources associated with the ImagingSelection.

property.name: subject
property.description: The patient, or group of patients, location, device, organization, procedure or practitioner this imaging selection is about and into whose or what record the imaging selection is placed.

property.name: issued
property.description: The date and time this imaging selection was created.

property.name: performer
property.description: Selector of the instances human or machine.

property.name: basedOn
property.description: A list of the diagnostic requests that resulted in this imaging selection being performed.

property.name: category
property.description: Classifies the imaging selection.

property.name: code
property.description: Reason for referencing the selected content.

property.name: studyUid
property.description: The Study Instance UID for the DICOM Study from which the images were selected.

property.name: derivedFrom
property.description: The imaging study from which the imaging selection is made.

property.name: endpoint
property.description: The network service providing retrieval access to the selected images, frames, etc. See implementation notes for information about using DICOM endpoints.

property.name: seriesUid
property.description: The Series Instance UID for the DICOM Series from which the images were selected.

property.name: seriesNumber
property.description: The Series Number for the DICOM Series from which the images were selected.

property.name: frameOfReferenceUid
property.description: The Frame of Reference UID identifying the coordinate system that conveys spatial and/or temporal information for the selected images or frames.

property.name: bodySite
property.description: The anatomic structures examined. See DICOM Part 16 Annex L (http://dicom.nema.org/medical/dicom/current/output/chtml/part16/chapter_L.html) for DICOM to SNOMED-CT mappings.

property.name: focus
property.description: The actual focus of an observation when it is not the patient of record representing something or someone associated with the patient such as a spouse, parent, fetus, or donor. For example, fetus observations in a mothers record. The focus of an observation could also be an existing condition, an intervention, the subjects diet, another observation of the subject, or a body structure such as tumor or implanted device. An example use case would be using the Observation resource to capture whether the mother is trained to change her childs tracheostomy tube. In this example, the child is the patient of record and the mother is the focus.

property.name: instance
property.description: Each imaging selection includes one or more selected DICOM SOP instances.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: function
property.description: Distinguishes the type of involvement of the performer.

property.name: actor
property.description: Author human or machine.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: uid
property.description: The SOP Instance UID for the selected DICOM instance.

property.name: number
property.description: The Instance Number for the selected DICOM instance.

property.name: sopClass
property.description: The SOP Class UID for the selected DICOM instance.

property.name: subset
property.description: Selected subset of the SOP Instance. The content and format of the subset item is determined by the SOP Class of the selected instance. May be one of: - A list of frame numbers selected from a multiframe SOP Instance. - A list of Content Item Observation UID values selected from a DICOM SR or other structured document SOP Instance. - A list of segment numbers selected from a segmentation SOP Instance. - A list of Region of Interest (ROI) numbers selected from a radiotherapy structure set SOP Instance.

property.name: imageRegion2D
property.description: Each imaging selection instance or frame list might includes an image region, specified by a region type and a set of 2D coordinates. If the parent imagingSelection.instance contains a subset element of type frame, the image region applies to all frames in the subset list.

property.name: imageRegion3D
property.description: Each imaging selection might includes a 3D image region, specified by a region type and a set of 3D coordinates.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: regionType
property.description: Specifies the type of image region.

property.name: coordinate
property.description: The coordinates describing the image region. Encoded as a set of (column, row) pairs that denote positions in the selected image / frames specified with sub-pixel resolution. The origin at the TLHC of the TLHC pixel is 0.0\0.0, the BRHC of the TLHC pixel is 1.0\1.0, and the BRHC of the BRHC pixel is the number of columns\rows in the image / frames. The values must be within the range 0\0 to the number of columns\rows in the image / frames.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: regionType
property.description: Specifies the type of image region.

property.name: coordinate
property.description: The coordinates describing the image region. Encoded as an ordered set of (x,y,z) triplets (in mm and may be negative) that define a region of interest in the patient-relative Reference Coordinate System defined by ImagingSelection.frameOfReferenceUid element.

codeset.name: ImagingSelectionStatus
codeset.description: The status of the ImagingSelection.

code.name: Available
code.description: The selected resources are available..

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The imaging selection has been withdrawn following a release. This electronic record should never have existed, though it is possible that real-world decisions were based on it. (If real-world activity has occurred, the status should be "cancelled" rather than "entered-in-error".).

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this request. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, its just not known which one.

codeset.name: ImagingSelection2DGraphicType
codeset.description: The type of 2D coordinates describing a 2D image region.

code.name: Point
code.description: A single location denoted by a single (x,y) pair.

code.name: Polyline
code.description: A series of connected line segments with ordered vertices denoted by (x,y) triplets; the points need not be coplanar.

code.name: Interpolated
code.description: An n-tuple list of (x,y) pair end points between which some form of implementation dependent curved lines are to be drawn. The rendered line shall pass through all the specified points.

code.name: Circle
code.description: Two points shall be present; the first point is to be interpreted as the center and the second point as a point on the circumference of a circle, some form of implementation dependent representation of which is to be drawn.

code.name: Ellipse
code.description: An ellipse defined by four (x,y) pairs, the first two pairs specifying the endpoints of the major axis and the second two pairs specifying the endpoints of the minor axis.

codeset.name: ImagingSelection3DGraphicType
codeset.description: The type of coordinates describing a 3D image region.

code.name: Point
code.description: A single location denoted by a single (x,y,z) triplet.

code.name: Multipoint
code.description: multiple locations each denoted by an (x,y,z) triplet; the points need not be coplanar.

code.name: Polyline
code.description: a series of connected line segments with ordered vertices denoted by (x,y,z) triplets; the points need not be coplanar.

code.name: Polygon
code.description: a series of connected line segments with ordered vertices denoted by (x,y,z) triplets, where the first and last vertices shall be the same forming a polygon; the points shall be coplanar.

code.name: Ellipse
code.description: an ellipse defined by four (x,y,z) triplets, the first two triplets specifying the endpoints of the major axis and the second two triplets specifying the endpoints of the minor axis.

code.name: Ellipsoid
code.description: a three-dimensional geometric surface whose plane sections are either ellipses or circles and contains three intersecting orthogonal axes, "a", "b", and "c"; the ellipsoid is defined by six (x,y,z) triplets, the first and second triplets specifying the endpoints of axis "a", the third and fourth triplets specifying the endpoints of axis "b", and the fifth and sixth triplets specifying the endpoints of axis "c".

resource.description: Representation of the content produced in a DICOM imaging study. A study comprises a set of series, each of which includes a set of Service-Object Pair Instances (SOP Instances - images or other data) acquired or produced in a common context. A series is of only one modality (e.g. X-ray, CT, MR, ultrasound), but a study may have multiple series of different modalities.

The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. property.name: identifier
property.description: Identifiers for the ImagingStudy such as DICOM Study Instance UID.

property.name: status
property.description: The current state of the ImagingStudy resource. This is not the status of any ServiceRequest or Task resources associated with the ImagingStudy.

property.name: modality
property.description: A list of all the distinct values of series.modality. This may include both acquisition and non-acquisition modalities.

property.name: subject
property.description: The subject, typically a patient, of the imaging study.

property.name: encounter
property.description: The healthcare event (e.g. a patient and healthcare provider interaction) during which this ImagingStudy is made.

property.name: started
property.description: Date and time the study started.

property.name: basedOn
property.description: A list of the diagnostic requests that resulted in this imaging study being performed.

property.name: partOf
property.description: A larger event of which this particular ImagingStudy is a component or step. For example, an ImagingStudy as part of a procedure.

property.name: referrer
property.description: The requesting/referring physician.

property.name: endpoint
property.description: The network service providing access (e.g., query, view, or retrieval) for the study. See implementation notes for information about using DICOM endpoints. A study-level endpoint applies to each series in the study, unless overridden by a series-level endpoint with the same Endpoint.connectionType.

property.name: numberOfSeries
property.description: Number of Series in the Study. This value given may be larger than the number of series elements this Resource contains due to resource availability, security, or other factors. This element should be present if any series elements are present.

property.name: numberOfInstances
property.description: Number of SOP Instances in Study. This value given may be larger than the number of instance elements this resource contains due to resource availability, security, or other factors. This element should be present if any instance elements are present.

property.name: procedure
property.description: This field corresponds to the DICOM Procedure Code Sequence (0008,1032). This is different from the FHIR Procedure resource that may include the ImagingStudy.

property.name: location
property.description: The principal physical location where the ImagingStudy was performed.

property.name: reason
property.description: Description of clinical condition indicating why the ImagingStudy was requested, and/or Indicates another resource whose existence justifies this Study.

property.name: note
property.description: Per the recommended DICOM mapping, this element is derived from the Study Description attribute (0008,1030). Observations or findings about the imaging study should be recorded in another resource, e.g. Observation, and not in this element.

property.name: description
property.description: The Imaging Manager description of the study. Institution-generated description or classification of the Study (component) performed.

property.name: series
property.description: Each study has one or more series of images or other content.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: uid
property.description: The DICOM Series Instance UID for the series.

property.name: number
property.description: The numeric identifier of this series in the study.

property.name: modality
property.description: The distinct modality for this series. This may include both acquisition and non-acquisition modalities.

property.name: description
property.description: A description of the series.

property.name: numberOfInstances
property.description: Number of SOP Instances in the Study. The value given may be larger than the number of instance elements this resource contains due to resource availability, security, or other factors. This element should be present if any instance elements are present.

property.name: endpoint
property.description: The network service providing access (e.g., query, view, or retrieval) for this series. See implementation notes for information about using DICOM endpoints. A series-level endpoint, if present, has precedence over a study-level endpoint with the same Endpoint.connectionType.

property.name: bodySite
property.description: The anatomic structures examined. See DICOM Part 16 Annex L (http://dicom.nema.org/medical/dicom/current/output/chtml/part16/chapter_L.html) for DICOM to SNOMED-CT mappings. The bodySite may indicate the laterality of body part imaged; if so, it shall be consistent with any content of ImagingStudy.series.laterality.

property.name: laterality
property.description: The laterality of the (possibly paired) anatomic structures examined. E.g., the left knee, both lungs, or unpaired abdomen. If present, shall be consistent with any laterality information indicated in ImagingStudy.series.bodySite.

property.name: specimen
property.description: The specimen imaged, e.g., for whole slide imaging of a biopsy.

property.name: started
property.description: The date and time the series was started.

property.name: performer
property.description: Indicates who or what performed the series and how they were involved.

property.name: instance
property.description: A single SOP instance within the series, e.g. an image, or presentation state.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: function
property.description: Distinguishes the type of involvement of the performer in the series.

property.name: actor
property.description: Indicates who or what performed the series.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: uid
property.description: The DICOM SOP Instance UID for this image or other DICOM content.

property.name: sopClass
property.description: DICOM instance type.

property.name: number
property.description: The number of instance in the series.

property.name: title
property.description: The description of the instance.

codeset.name: ImagingStudyStatus
codeset.description: The status of the ImagingStudy.

code.name: Registered
code.description: The existence of the imaging study is registered, but there is nothing yet available.

code.name: Available
code.description: At least one instance has been associated with this imaging study.

code.name: Cancelled
code.description: The imaging study is unavailable because the imaging study was not started or not completed (also sometimes called "aborted").

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The imaging study has been withdrawn following a previous final release. This electronic record should never have existed, though it is possible that real-world decisions were based on it. (If real-world activity has occurred, the status should be "cancelled" rather than "entered-in-error".).

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this request. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, its just not known which one.

resource.name: Immunization
resource.description: Describes the event of a patient being administered a vaccine or a record of an immunization as reported by a patient, a clinician or another party.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: A unique identifier assigned to this immunization record.

property.name: basedOn
property.description: A plan, order or recommendation fulfilled in whole or in part by this immunization.

property.name: status
property.description: Indicates the current status of the immunization event.

property.name: statusReason
property.description: Indicates the reason the immunization event was not performed.

property.name: vaccineCode
property.description: Vaccine that was administered or was to be administered.

property.name: administeredProduct
property.description: An indication of which product was administered to the patient. This is typically a more detailed representation of the concept conveyed by the vaccineCode data element. If a Medication resource is referenced, it may be to a stand-alone resource or a contained resource within the Immunization resource.

property.name: manufacturer
property.description: Name of vaccine manufacturer.

property.name: lotNumber
property.description: Lot number of the vaccine product.

property.name: expirationDate
property.description: Date vaccine batch expires.

property.name: patient
property.description: The patient who either received or did not receive the immunization.

property.name: encounter
property.description: The visit or admission or other contact between patient and health care provider the immunization was performed as part of.

property.name: supportingInformation
property.description: Additional information that is relevant to the immunization (e.g. for a vaccine recipient who is pregnant, the gestational age of the fetus). The reason why a vaccine was given (e.g. occupation, underlying medical condition) should be conveyed in Immunization.reason, not as supporting information. The reason why a vaccine was not given (e.g. contraindication) should be conveyed in Immunization.statusReason, not as supporting information.

property.name: occurrence
property.description: Date vaccine administered or was to be administered.

property.name: primarySource
property.description: Indicates whether the data contained in the resource was captured by the individual/organization which was responsible for the administration of the vaccine rather than as secondary reported data documented by a third party. A value of true means this data originated with the individual/organization which was responsible for the administration of the vaccine.

property.name: informationSource
property.description: Typically the source of the data when the report of the immunization event is not based on information from the person who administered the vaccine.

property.name: location
property.description: The service delivery location where the vaccine administration occurred.

property.name: site
property.description: Body site where vaccine was administered.

property.name: route
property.description: The path by which the vaccine product is taken into the body.

property.name: doseQuantity
property.description: The quantity of vaccine product that was administered.

property.name: performer
property.description: Indicates who performed the immunization event.

property.name: note
property.description: Extra information about the immunization that is not conveyed by the other attributes.

property.name: reason
property.description: Describes why the immunization occurred in coded or textual form, or Indicates another resource (Condition, Observation or DiagnosticReport) whose existence justifies this immunization.

property.name: isSubpotent
property.description: Indication if a dose is considered to be subpotent. By default, a dose should be considered to be potent.

property.name: subpotentReason
property.description: Reason why a dose is considered to be subpotent.

property.name: programEligibility
property.description: Indicates a patients eligibility for a funding program.

property.name: fundingSource
property.description: Indicates the source of the vaccine actually administered. This may be different than the patient eligibility (e.g. the patient may be eligible for a publically purchased vaccine but due to inventory issues, vaccine purchased with private funds was actually administered).

property.name: reaction
property.description: Categorical data indicating that an adverse event is associated in time to an immunization.

property.name: protocolApplied
property.description: The protocol (set of recommendations) being followed by the provider who administered the dose.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: function
property.description: Describes the type of performance (e.g. ordering provider, administering provider, etc.).

property.name: actor
property.description: The practitioner or organization who performed the action.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: program
property.description: Indicates which program the patient had their eligility evaluated for.

property.name: programStatus
property.description: Indicates the patients eligility status for for a specific payment program.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: date
property.description: Date of reaction to the immunization.

property.name: manifestation
property.description: Details of the reaction.

property.name: reported
property.description: Self-reported indicator.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: series
property.description: One possible path to achieve presumed immunity against a disease - within the context of an authority.

property.name: authority
property.description: Indicates the authority who published the protocol (e.g. ACIP) that is being followed.

property.name: targetDisease
property.description: The vaccine preventable disease the dose is being administered against.

property.name: doseNumber
property.description: Nominal position in a series as intended by the practitioner administering the dose.

property.name: seriesDoses
property.description: The recommended number of doses to achieve immunity as intended by the practitioner administering the dose.

codeset.name: ImmunizationStatusCodes
codeset.description: The value set to instantiate this attribute should be drawn from a terminologically robust code system that consists of or contains concepts to support describing the current status of the administered dose of vaccine.

property.name: identifier
property.description: A unique identifier assigned to this immunization evaluation record.

property.name: status
property.description: Indicates the current status of the evaluation of the vaccination administration event.

property.name: patient
property.description: The individual for whom the evaluation is being done.

property.name: date
property.description: The date the evaluation of the vaccine administration event was performed.

property.name: authority
property.description: Indicates the authority who published the protocol (e.g. ACIP).

property.name: targetDisease
property.description: The vaccine preventable disease the dose is being evaluated against.

property.name: immunizationEvent
property.description: The vaccine administration event being evaluated.

property.name: doseStatus
property.description: Indicates if the dose is valid or not valid with respect to the published recommendations.

property.name: doseStatusReason
property.description: Provides an explanation as to why the vaccine administration event is valid or not relative to the published recommendations.

property.name: description
property.description: Additional information about the evaluation.

property.name: series
property.description: One possible path to achieve presumed immunity against a disease - within the context of an authority.

property.name: doseNumber
property.description: Nominal position in a series as determined by the outcome of the evaluation process.

property.name: seriesDoses
property.description: The recommended number of doses to achieve immunity as determined by the outcome of the evaluation process.

codeset.name: ImmunizationEvaluationStatusCodes
codeset.description: The value set to instantiate this attribute should be drawn from a terminologically robust code system that consists of or contains concepts to support describing the current status of the evaluation for vaccine administration event.

resource.name: ImmunizationRecommendation
resource.description: A patients point-in-time set of recommendations (i.e. forecasting) according to a published schedule with optional supporting justification.

property.name: identifier
property.description: A unique identifier assigned to this particular recommendation record.

property.name: patient
property.description: The patient the recommendation(s) are for.

property.name: date
property.description: The date the immunization recommendation(s) were created.

property.name: authority
property.description: Indicates the authority who published the protocol (e.g. ACIP).

property.name: recommendation
property.description: Vaccine administration recommendations.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: vaccineCode
property.description: Vaccine(s) or vaccine group that pertain to the recommendation.

property.name: targetDisease
property.description: The targeted disease for the recommendation.

property.name: contraindicatedVaccineCode
property.description: Vaccine(s) which should not be used to fulfill the recommendation.

property.name: forecastStatus
property.description: Indicates the patient status with respect to the path to immunity for the target disease.

property.name: forecastReason
property.description: The reason for the assigned forecast status.

property.name: dateCriterion
property.description: Vaccine date recommendations. For example, earliest date to administer, latest date to administer, etc.

property.name: description
property.description: Contains the description about the protocol under which the vaccine was administered.

property.name: series
property.description: One possible path to achieve presumed immunity against a disease - within the context of an authority.

property.name: doseNumber
property.description: Nominal position of the recommended dose in a series as determined by the evaluation and forecasting process (e.g. dose 2 is the next recommended dose).

property.name: seriesDoses
property.description: The recommended number of doses to achieve immunity as determined by the evaluation and forecasting process.

property.name: supportingImmunization
property.description: Immunization event history and/or evaluation that supports the status and recommendation.

property.name: supportingPatientInformation
property.description: Patient Information that supports the status and recommendation. This includes patient observations, adverse reactions and allergy/intolerance information.

property.name: value

resource.name: Ingredient
resource.description: An ingredient of a manufactured item or pharmaceutical product.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: The identifier(s) of this Ingredient that are assigned by business processes and/or used to refer to it when a direct URL reference to the resource itself is not appropriate.

property.name: status
property.description: The status of this ingredient. Enables tracking the life-cycle of the content.

property.name: for
property.description: The product which this ingredient is a constituent part of.

property.name: role
property.description: A classification of the ingredient identifying its purpose within the product, e.g. active, inactive.

property.name: function
property.description: A classification of the ingredient identifying its precise purpose(s) in the drug product. This extends the Ingredient.role to add more detail. Example: antioxidant, alkalizing agent.

property.name: group
property.description: A classification of the ingredient according to where in the physical item it tends to be used, such the outer shell of a tablet, inner body or ink.

property.name: allergenicIndicator
property.description: If the ingredient is a known or suspected allergen. Note that this is a property of the substance, so if a reference to a SubstanceDefinition is used to decribe that (rather than just a code), the allergen information should go there, not here.

property.name: comment
property.description: A place for providing any notes that are relevant to the component, e.g. removed during process, adjusted for loss on drying.

property.name: manufacturer
property.description: The organization(s) that manufacture this ingredient. Can be used to indicate: 1) Organizations we are aware of that manufacture this ingredient 2) Specific Manufacturer(s) currently being used 3) Set of organisations allowed to manufacture this ingredient for this product Users must be clear on the application of context relevant to their use case.

property.name: substance
property.description: The substance that comprises this ingredient.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: role
property.description: The way in which this manufacturer is associated with the ingredient. For example whether it is a possible one (others allowed), or an exclusive authorized one for this ingredient. Note that this is not the manufacturing process role.

property.name: manufacturer
property.description: An organization that manufactures this ingredient.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: code
property.description: A code or full resource that represents the ingredients substance.

property.name: strength
property.description: The quantity of substance in the unit of presentation, or in the volume (or mass) of the single pharmaceutical product or manufactured item. The allowed repetitions do not represent different strengths, but are different representations - mathematically equivalent - of a single strength.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: presentation
property.description: The quantity of substance in the unit of presentation, or in the volume (or mass) of the single pharmaceutical product or manufactured item. Unit of presentation refers to the quantity that the item occurs in e.g. a strength per tablet size, perhaps per 20mg (the size of the tablet). It is not generally normalized as a unitary unit, which would be per mg).

property.name: textPresentation
property.description: A textual represention of either the whole of the presentation strength or a part of it - with the rest being in Strength.presentation as a ratio.

property.name: concentration
property.description: The strength per unitary volume (or mass).

property.name: textConcentration
property.description: A textual represention of either the whole of the concentration strength or a part of it - with the rest being in Strength.concentration as a ratio.

property.name: basis
property.description: A code that indicates if the strength is, for example, based on the ingredient substance as stated or on the substance base (when the ingredient is a salt).

property.name: measurementPoint
property.description: For when strength is measured at a particular point or distance. There are products where strength is measured at a particular point. For example, the strength of the ingredient in some inhalers is measured at a particular position relative to the point of aerosolization.

property.name: country
property.description: The country or countries for which the strength range applies.

property.name: referenceStrength
property.description: Strength expressed in terms of a reference substance. For when the ingredient strength is additionally expressed as equivalent to the strength of some other closely related substance (e.g. salt vs. base). Reference strength represents the strength (quantitative composition) of the active moiety of the active substance. There are situations when the active substance and active moiety are different, therefore both a strength and a reference strength are needed.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: substance
property.description: Relevant reference substance.

property.name: strength
property.description: Strength expressed in terms of a reference substance.

property.name: measurementPoint
property.description: For when strength is measured at a particular point or distance.

property.name: country
property.description: The country or countries for which the strength range applies.

codeset.name: IngredientManufacturerRole
codeset.description: The way in which this manufacturer is associated with the ingredient. For example whether it is a possible one (others allowed), or an exclusive authorized one for this ingredient. Note that this is not the manufacturing process role.

property.name: meta

property.name: identifier
property.description: Business identifiers assigned to this health insurance product which remain constant as the resource is updated and propagates from server to server.

property.name: status
property.description: The current state of the health insurance product.

property.name: type
property.description: The kind of health insurance product.

property.name: name
property.description: Official name of the health insurance product as designated by the owner.

property.name: alias
property.description: A list of alternate names that the product is known as, or was known as in the past.

property.name: period
property.description: The period of time that the health insurance product is available.

property.name: ownedBy
property.description: The entity that is providing the health insurance product and underwriting the risk. This is typically an insurance carriers, other third-party payers, or health plan sponsors comonly referred to as payers.

property.name: administeredBy
property.description: An organization which administer other services such as underwriting, customer service and/or claims processing on behalf of the health insurance product owner.

property.name: coverageArea
property.description: The geographic region in which a health insurance products benefits apply.

property.name: contact
property.description: The contact details of communication devices available relevant to the specific Insurance Plan/Product. This can include addresses, phone numbers, fax numbers, mobile numbers, email addresses and web sites.

property.name: endpoint
property.description: The technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the health insurance product.

property.name: network
property.description: Reference to the network included in the health insurance product.

property.name: coverage
property.description: Details about the coverage offered by the insurance product.

property.name: plan
property.description: Details about an insurance plan.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: Type of coverage (Medical; Dental; Mental Health; Substance Abuse; Vision; Drug; Short Term; Long Term Care; Hospice; Home Health).

property.name: network
property.description: Reference to the network that providing the type of coverage.

property.name: benefit
property.description: Specific benefits under this type of coverage.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: Type of benefit (primary care; speciality care; inpatient; outpatient).

property.name: requirement
property.description: The referral requirements to have access/coverage for this benefit.

property.name: limit
property.description: The specific limits on the benefit.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: value
property.description: The maximum amount of a service item a plan will pay for a covered benefit. For examples. wellness visits, or eyeglasses.

property.name: code
property.description: The specific limit on the benefit.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Business identifiers assigned to this health insurance plan which remain constant as the resource is updated and propagates from server to server.

property.name: type
property.description: Type of plan. For example, "Platinum" or "High Deductable".

property.name: coverageArea
property.description: The geographic region in which a health insurance plans benefits apply.

property.name: network
property.description: Reference to the network that providing the type of coverage.

property.name: generalCost
property.description: Overall costs associated with the plan.

property.name: specificCost
property.description: Costs associated with the coverage provided by the product.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: Type of cost.

property.name: groupSize
property.description: Number of participants enrolled in the plan.

property.name: cost
property.description: Value of the cost.

property.name: comment
property.description: Additional information about the general costs associated with this plan.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: category
property.description: General category of benefit (Medical; Dental; Vision; Drug; Mental Health; Substance Abuse; Hospice, Home Health).

property.name: benefit
property.description: List of the specific benefits under this category of benefit.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: Type of specific benefit (preventative; primary care office visit; speciality office visit; hospitalization; emergency room; urgent care).

property.name: cost
property.description: List of the costs associated with a specific benefit.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: Type of cost (copay; individual cap; family cap; coinsurance; deductible).

property.name: applicability
property.description: Whether the cost applies to in-network or out-of-network providers (in-network; out-of-network; other).

property.name: qualifiers
property.description: Additional information about the cost, such as information about funding sources (e.g. HSA, HRA, FSA, RRA).

property.name: value
property.description: The actual cost value. (some of the costs may be represented as percentages rather than currency, e.g. 10% coinsurance).

resource.name: InventoryItem

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules

property.name: identifier
property.description: Business identifier for the inventory item.

property.name: status
property.description: Status of the item entry.

property.name: category

property.name: code
