property.name: name
property.description: The item name(s) - the brand name, or common name, functional name, generic name.

property.name: responsibleOrganization
property.description: Organization(s) responsible for the product.

property.name: description
property.description: The descriptive characteristics of the inventory item.

property.name: inventoryStatus
property.description: The usage status e.g. recalled, in use, discarded... This can be used to indicate that the items have been taken out of inventory, or are in use, etc.

property.name: baseUnit
property.description: The base unit of measure - the unit in which the product is used or counted.

property.name: netContent
property.description: Net content or amount present in the item.

property.name: association
property.description: Association with other items or products.

property.name: characteristic
property.description: The descriptive or identifying characteristics of the item.

property.name: instance
property.description: Instances or occurrences of the product.

property.name: productReference
property.description: Link to a product resource used in clinical workflows.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: nameType
property.description: The type of name e.g. brand-name, functional-name, common-name.

property.name: language
property.description: The language that the item name is expressed in.

property.name: name
property.description: The name or designation that the item is given.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: role
property.description: The role of the organization e.g. manufacturer, distributor, etc.

property.name: organization
property.description: An organization that has an association with the item, e.g. manufacturer, distributor, responsible, etc.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: language
property.description: The language for the item description, when an item must be described in different languages and those languages may be authoritative and not translations of a main language.

property.name: description
property.description: Textual description of the item.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: associationType
property.description: This attribute defined the type of association when establishing associations or relations between items, e.g. packaged within or used with or to be mixed with.

property.name: relatedItem
property.description: The related item or product.

property.name: quantity
property.description: The quantity of the related product in this product - Numerator is the quantity of the related product. Denominator is the quantity of the present product. For example a value of 20 means that this product contains 20 units of the related product; a value of 1:20 means the inverse - that the contained product contains 20 units of the present product.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: characteristicType
property.description: The type of characteristic that is being defined.

property.name: value
property.description: The value of the attribute.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: identifier
property.description: The identifier for the physical instance, typically a serial number.

property.name: lotNumber
property.description: The lot or batch number of the item.

property.name: expiry
property.description: The expiry date or date and time for the product.

property.name: subject
property.description: The subject that the item is associated with.

property.name: location
property.description: The location that the item is associated with.

codeset.name: InventoryItemStatusCodes
codeset.description: InventoryItem Status Codes

code.name: Active
code.description: The item is active and can be referenced.

code.name: Inactive
code.description: The item is presently inactive - there may be references to it but the item is not expected to be used.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The item record was entered in error.

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The item status has not been determined.

resource.name: InventoryReport
resource.description: A report of inventory or stock items.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Business identifier for the InventoryReport.

property.name: status
property.description: The status of the inventory check or notification - whether this is draft (e.g. the report is still pending some updates) or active.

property.name: countType
property.description: Whether the report is about the current inventory count (snapshot) or a differential change in inventory (change).

property.name: operationType
property.description: What type of operation is being performed - addition or subtraction.

property.name: operationTypeReason
property.description: The reason for this count - regular count, ad-hoc count, new arrivals, etc.

property.name: reportedDateTime
property.description: When the report has been submitted.

property.name: reporter
property.description: Who submits the report.

property.name: reportingPeriod
property.description: The period the report refers to.

property.name: inventoryListing
property.description: An inventory listing section (grouped by any of the attributes).

property.name: note
property.description: A note associated with the InventoryReport.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: location
property.description: Location of the inventory items.

property.name: itemStatus
property.description: The status of the items.

property.name: countingDateTime
property.description: The date and time when the items were counted.

property.name: item
property.description: The item or items in this listing.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: category
property.description: The inventory category or classification of the items being reported. This is meant not for defining the product, but for inventory categories e.g. pending recount or damaged.

property.name: quantity
property.description: The quantity of the item or items being reported.

property.name: item
property.description: The code or reference to the item type.

codeset.name: InventoryReportStatus
codeset.description: The status of the InventoryReport.

code.name: Draft
code.description: The existence of the report is registered, but it is still without content or only some preliminary content.

code.name: Requested
code.description: The inventory report has been requested but there is no data available.

code.name: Active
code.description: This report is submitted as current.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The report has been withdrawn following a previous final release. This electronic record should never have existed, though it is possible that real-world decisions were based on it.

codeset.name: InventoryCountType
codeset.description: The type of count.

code.name: Snapshot
code.description: The inventory report is a current absolute snapshot, i.e. it represents the quantities at hand.

code.name: Difference
code.description: The inventory report is about the difference between a previous count and a current count, i.e. it represents the items that have been added/subtracted from inventory.

resource.name: Invoice
resource.description: Invoice containing collected ChargeItems from an Account with calculated individual and total price for Billing purpose.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Identifier of this Invoice, often used for reference in correspondence about this invoice or for tracking of payments.

property.name: status
property.description: The current state of the Invoice.

property.name: cancelledReason
property.description: In case of Invoice cancellation a reason must be given (entered in error, superseded by corrected invoice etc.).

property.name: type
property.description: Type of Invoice depending on domain, realm an usage (e.g. internal/external, dental, preliminary).

property.name: subject
property.description: The individual or set of individuals receiving the goods and services billed in this invoice.

property.name: recipient
property.description: The individual or Organization responsible for balancing of this invoice.

property.name: date
property.description: Depricared by the element below.

property.name: creation
property.description: Date/time(s) of when this Invoice was posted.

property.name: period
property.description: Date/time(s) range of services included in this invoice.

property.name: participant
property.description: Indicates who or what performed or participated in the charged service.

property.name: issuer
property.description: The organizationissuing the Invoice.

property.name: account
property.description: Account which is supposed to be balanced with this Invoice.

property.name: lineItem
property.description: Each line item represents one charge for goods and services rendered. Details such.ofType(date), code and amount are found in the referenced ChargeItem resource.

property.name: totalPriceComponent
property.description: The total amount for the Invoice may be calculated as the sum of the line items with surcharges/deductions that apply in certain conditions. The priceComponent element can be used to offer transparency to the recipient of the Invoice of how the total price was calculated.

property.name: totalNet
property.description: Invoice total , taxes excluded.

property.name: totalGross
property.description: Invoice total, tax included.

property.name: paymentTerms
property.description: Payment details such as banking details, period of payment, deductibles, methods of payment.

property.name: note
property.description: Comments made about the invoice by the issuer, subject, or other participants.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: role
property.description: Describes the type of involvement (e.g. transcriptionist, creator etc.). If the invoice has been created automatically, the Participant may be a billing engine or another kind of device.

property.name: actor
property.description: The device, practitioner, etc. who performed or participated in the service.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: sequence
property.description: Sequence in which the items appear on the invoice.

property.name: serviced
property.description: Date/time(s) range when this service was delivered or completed.

property.name: chargeItem
property.description: The ChargeItem contains information such as the billing code, date, amount etc. If no further details are required for the lineItem, inline billing codes can be added using the CodeableConcept data type instead of the Reference.

property.name: priceComponent
property.description: The price for a ChargeItem may be calculated as a base price with surcharges/deductions that apply in certain conditions. A ChargeItemDefinition resource that defines the prices, factors and conditions that apply to a billing code is currently under development. The priceComponent element can be used to offer transparency to the recipient of the Invoice as to how the prices have been calculated.

codeset.name: InvoiceStatus
codeset.description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of an Invoice.

code.name: Draft
code.description: the invoice has been prepared but not yet finalized.

code.name: Issued
code.description: the invoice has been finalized and sent to the recipient.

code.name: Balanced
code.description: the invoice has been balaced / completely paid.

code.name: Cancelled
code.description: the invoice was cancelled.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: the invoice was determined as entered in error before it was issued.

resource.name: Library
resource.description: The Library resource is a general-purpose container for knowledge asset definitions. It can be used to describe and expose existing knowledge assets such as logic libraries and information model descriptions, as well as to describe a collection of knowledge assets.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: url
property.description: An absolute URI that is used to identify this library when it is referenced in a specification, model, design or an instance; also called its canonical identifier. This SHOULD be globally unique and SHOULD be a literal address at which an authoritative instance of this library is (or will be) published. This URL can be the target of a canonical reference. It SHALL remain the same when the library is stored on different servers.

property.name: identifier
property.description: A formal identifier that is used to identify this library when it is represented in other formats, or referenced in a specification, model, design or an instance. e.g. CMS or NQF identifiers for a measure artifact. Note that at least one identifier is required for non-experimental active artifacts.

property.name: version
property.description: The identifier that is used to identify this version of the library when it is referenced in a specification, model, design or instance. This is an arbitrary value managed by the library author and is not expected to be globally unique. For example, it might be a timestamp (e.g. yyyymmdd) if a managed version is not available. There is also no expectation that versions can be placed in a lexicographical sequence. To provide a version consistent with the Decision Support Service specification, use the format Major.Minor.Revision (e.g. 1.0.0). For more information on versioning knowledge assets, refer to the Decision Support Service specification. Note that a version is required for non-experimental active artifacts.

property.name: versionAlgorithm
property.description: Indicates the mechanism used to compare versions to determine which is more current.

property.name: name
property.description: A natural language name identifying the library. This name should be usable as an identifier for the module by machine processing applications such as code generation.

property.name: title
property.description: A short, descriptive, user-friendly title for the library.

property.name: subtitle
property.description: An explanatory or alternate title for the library giving additional information about its content.

property.name: status
property.description: The status of this library. Enables tracking the life-cycle of the content.

property.name: experimental
property.description: A Boolean value to indicate that this library is authored for testing purposes (or education/evaluation/marketing) and is not intended to be used for genuine usage.

property.name: type
property.description: Identifies the type of library such as a Logic Library, Model Definition, Asset Collection, or Module Definition.

property.name: subject
property.description: A code or group definition that describes the intended subject of the contents of the library.

property.name: date
property.description: The date (and optionally time) when the library was last significantly changed. The date must change when the business version changes and it must change if the status code changes. In addition, it should change when the substantive content of the library changes.

property.name: publisher
property.description: The name of the organization or individual responsible for the release and ongoing maintenance of the library.

property.name: contact
property.description: Contact details to assist a user in finding and communicating with the publisher.

property.name: description
property.description: A free text natural language description of the library from a consumers perspective.

property.name: useContext
property.description: The content was developed with a focus and intent of supporting the contexts that are listed. These contexts may be general categories (gender, age, ...) or may be references to specific programs (insurance plans, studies, ...) and may be used to assist with indexing and searching for appropriate library instances.

property.name: jurisdiction
property.description: A legal or geographic region in which the library is intended to be used.

property.name: purpose
property.description: Explanation of why this library is needed and why it has been designed as it has.

property.name: usage
property.description: A detailed description of how the library is used from a clinical perspective.

property.name: copyright
property.description: A copyright statement relating to the library and/or its contents. Copyright statements are generally legal restrictions on the use and publishing of the library.

property.name: copyrightLabel
property.description: A short string (lower than50 characters), suitable for inclusion in a page footer that identifies the copyright holder, effective period, and optionally whether rights are resctricted. (e.g. All rights reserved, Some rights reserved).

property.name: approvalDate
property.description: The date on which the resource content was approved by the publisher. Approval happens once when the content is officially approved for usage.

property.name: lastReviewDate
property.description: The date on which the resource content was last reviewed. Review happens periodically after approval but does not change the original approval date.

property.name: effectivePeriod
property.description: The period during which the library content was or is planned to be in active use.

property.name: topic
property.description: Descriptive topics related to the content of the library. Topics provide a high-level categorization of the library that can be useful for filtering and searching.

property.name: author
property.description: An individiual or organization primarily involved in the creation and maintenance of the content.

property.name: editor
property.description: An individual or organization primarily responsible for internal coherence of the content.

property.name: reviewer
property.description: An individual or organization asserted by the publisher to be primarily responsible for review of some aspect of the content.

property.name: endorser
property.description: An individual or organization asserted by the publisher to be responsible for officially endorsing the content for use in some setting.

property.name: relatedArtifact
property.description: Related artifacts such as additional documentation, justification, or bibliographic references.

property.name: parameter
property.description: The parameter element defines parameters used by the library.

property.name: dataRequirement
property.description: Describes a set of data that must be provided in order to be able to successfully perform the computations defined by the library.

property.name: content
property.description: The content of the library as an Attachment. The content may be a reference to a url, or may be directly embedded as a base-64 string. Either way, the contentType of the attachment determines how to interpret the content.

operation.name: data-requirements
operation.description: The data-requirements operation aggregates and returns the parameters and data requirements for a resource and all its dependencies as a single module definition

parameter.name: target
parameter.description: The target of the data requirements operation

parameter.name: return
parameter.description: The result of the requirements gathering

resource.name: Linkage
resource.description: Identifies two or more records (resource instances) that refer to the same real-world "occurrence".

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: active
property.description: Indicates whether the asserted set of linkages are considered to be "in effect".

property.name: author
property.description: Identifies the user or organization responsible for asserting the linkages as well as the user or organization who establishes the context in which the nature of each linkage is evaluated.

property.name: item
property.description: Identifies which record considered as the reference to the same real-world occurrence as well as how the items should be evaluated within the collection of linked items.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: Distinguishes which item is "source of truth" (if any) and which items are no longer considered to be current representations.

property.name: resource
property.description: The resource instance being linked as part of the group.

codeset.name: LinkageType
codeset.description: Used to distinguish different roles a resource can play within a set of linked resources.

code.name: Source
code.description: The resource represents the "source of truth" (from the perspective of this Linkage resource) for the underlying event/condition/etc.

code.name: Alternate
code.description: The resource represents an alternative view of the underlying event/condition/etc. The resource may still be actively maintained, even though it is not considered to be the source of truth.

code.name: Historical
code.description: The resource represents an obsolete record of the underlying event/condition/etc. It is not expected to be actively maintained.

resource.name: List
resource.description: A List is a curated collection of resources, for things such as problem lists, allergy lists, facility list, organization list, etc.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Identifier for the List assigned for business purposes outside the context of FHIR.

property.name: status
property.description: Indicates the current state of this list.

property.name: mode
property.description: How this list was prepared - whether it is a working list that is suitable for being maintained on an ongoing basis, or if it represents a snapshot of a list of items from another source, or whether it is a prepared list where items may be marked as added, modified or deleted.

property.name: title
property.description: A label for the list assigned by the author.

property.name: code
property.description: This code defines the purpose of the list - why it was created.

property.name: subject
property.description: The common subject(s) (or patient(s)) of the resources that are in the list if there is one (or a set of subjects).

property.name: encounter
property.description: The encounter that is the context in which this list was created.

property.name: date
property.description: Date list was last reviewed/revised and determined to be current.

property.name: source
property.description: The entity responsible for deciding what the contents of the list were. Where the list was created by a human, this is the same as the author of the list.

property.name: orderedBy
property.description: What order applies to the items in the list.

property.name: note
property.description: Comments that apply to the overall list.

property.name: entry
property.description: Entries in this list.

property.name: emptyReason
property.description: If the list is empty, why the list is empty.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: flag
property.description: The flag allows the system constructing the list to indicate the role and significance of the item in the list.

property.name: deleted
property.description: True if this item is marked as deleted in the list.

property.name: date
property.description: When this item was added to the list.

property.name: item
property.description: A reference to the actual resource from which data was derived.

codeset.name: ListStatus
codeset.description: The current state of the list.

code.name: Current
code.description: The list is considered to be an active part of the patients record.

code.name: Retired
code.description: The list is "old" and should no longer be considered accurate or relevant.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The list was never accurate. It is retained for medico-legal purposes only.

operation.name: find
operation.description: This operation allows a client to find an identified list for a particular function by its function. The operation takes two parameters, the identity of a patient, and the name of a functional list. The list of defined functional lists can be found at [Current Resource Lists](lifecycle.html#lists). Applications are not required to support all the lists, and may define additional lists of their own. If the system is able to locate a list that serves the identified purpose, it returns it as the body of the response with a 200 OK status. If the resource cannot be located, the server returns a 404 not found (optionally with an OperationOutcome resource)

parameter.name: patient
parameter.description: The id of a patient resource located on the server on which this operation is executed

parameter.name: name
parameter.description: The code for the functional list that is being found

resource.name: Location
resource.description: Details and position information for a place where services are provided and resources and participants may be stored, found, contained, or accommodated.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Unique code or number identifying the location to its users.

property.name: status
property.description: The status property covers the general availability of the resource, not the current value which may be covered by the operationStatus, or by a schedule/slots if they are configured for the location.

property.name: operationalStatus
property.description: The operational status covers operation values most relevant to beds (but can also apply to rooms/units/chairs/etc. such as an isolation unit/dialysis chair). This typically covers concepts such as contamination, housekeeping, and other activities like maintenance.

property.name: name
property.description: Name of the location as used by humans. Does not need to be unique.

property.name: alias
property.description: A list of alternate names that the location is known as, or was known as, in the past.

property.name: description
property.description: Description of the Location, which helps in finding or referencing the place.

property.name: mode
property.description: Indicates whether a resource instance represents a specific location or a class of locations.

property.name: type
property.description: Indicates the type of function performed at the location.

property.name: contact
property.description: The contact details of communication devices available at the location. This can include addresses, phone numbers, fax numbers, mobile numbers, email addresses and web sites.

property.name: address
property.description: Physical location.

property.name: form
property.description: Physical form of the location, e.g. building, room, vehicle, road, virtual.

property.name: position
property.description: The absolute geographic location of the Location, expressed using the WGS84 datum (This is the same co-ordinate system used in KML).

property.name: managingOrganization
property.description: The organization responsible for the provisioning and upkeep of the location.

property.name: partOf
property.description: Another Location of which this Location is physically a part of.

property.name: characteristic
property.description: Collection of characteristics (attributes).

property.name: hoursOfOperation
property.description: What days/times during a week is this location usually open, and any exceptions where the location is not available.

property.name: virtualService
property.description: Connection details of a virtual service (e.g. shared conference call facility with dedicated number/details).

property.name: endpoint
property.description: Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the location.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: longitude
property.description: Longitude. The value domain and the interpretation are the same as for the text of the longitude element in KML (see notes on Location main page).

property.name: latitude
property.description: Latitude. The value domain and the interpretation are the same as for the text of the latitude element in KML (see notes on Location main page).

property.name: altitude
property.description: Altitude. The value domain and the interpretation are the same as for the text of the altitude element in KML (see notes on Location main page).

codeset.name: LocationStatus
codeset.description: Indicates whether the location is still in use.

code.name: Active
code.description: The location is operational.

code.name: Suspended
code.description: The location is temporarily closed.

code.name: Inactive
code.description: The location is no longer used.

codeset.name: LocationMode
codeset.description: Indicates whether a resource instance represents a specific location or a class of locations.

code.name: Instance
code.description: The Location resource represents a specific instance of a location (e.g. Operating Theatre 1A).

code.name: Kind
code.description: The Location represents a class of locations (e.g. Any Operating Theatre) although this class of locations could be constrained within a specific boundary (such as organization, or parent location, address etc.).

resource.name: ManufacturedItemDefinition
resource.description: The definition and characteristics of a medicinal manufactured item, such as a tablet or capsule, as contained in a packaged medicinal product.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Unique identifier.

property.name: status
property.description: The status of this item. Enables tracking the life-cycle of the content.

property.name: name
property.description: A descriptive name applied to this item.

property.name: manufacturedDoseForm
property.description: Dose form as manufactured and before any transformation into the pharmaceutical product.

property.name: unitOfPresentation
property.description: The real-world units in which the quantity of the manufactured item is described.

property.name: manufacturer
property.description: Manufacturer of the item, one of several possible.

property.name: marketingStatus
property.description: Allows specifying that an item is on the market for sale, or that it is not available, and the dates and locations associated.

property.name: ingredient
property.description: The ingredients of this manufactured item. This is only needed if the ingredients are not specified by incoming references from the Ingredient resource.

property.name: property
property.description: General characteristics of this item.

property.name: component
property.description: Physical parts of the manufactured item, that it is intrisically made from. This is distinct from the ingredients that are part of its chemical makeup.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: A code expressing the type of characteristic.

property.name: value
property.description: A value for the characteristic.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: Defining type of the component e.g. shell, layer, ink.

property.name: function
property.description: The function of this component within the item e.g. delivers active ingredient, masks taste.

property.name: amount
property.description: The measurable amount of total quantity of all substances in the component, expressable in different ways (e.g. by mass or volume).

property.name: constituent
property.description: A reference to a constituent of the manufactured item as a whole, linked here so that its component location within the item can be indicated. This not where the items ingredient are primarily stated (for which see Ingredient.for or ManufacturedItemDefinition.ingredient).

property.name: property
property.description: General characteristics of this component.

property.name: component
property.description: A component that this component contains or is made from.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: amount
property.description: The measurable amount of the substance, expressable in different ways (e.g. by mass or volume).

property.name: location
property.description: The physical location of the constituent/ingredient within the component. Example if the component is the bead in the capsule, then the location would be where the ingredient resides within the product part intragranular, extra-granular, etc.

property.name: function
property.description: The function of this constituent within the component e.g. binder.

property.name: hasIngredient
property.description: The ingredient that is the constituent of the given component.

property.name: disclaimer

property.name: scoring
property.description: Indicates how the calculation is performed for the measure, including proportion, ratio, continuous-variable, and cohort. The value set is extensible, allowing additional measure scoring types to be represented.

property.name: scoringUnit
property.description: Defines the expected units of measure for the measure score. This element SHOULD be specified as a UCUM unit.

property.name: compositeScoring

property.name: riskAdjustment
property.description: A description of the risk adjustment factors that may impact the resulting score for the measure and how they may be accounted for when computing and reporting measure results.

property.name: rateAggregation
property.description: Describes how to combine the information calculated, based on logic in each of several populations, into one summarized result.

property.name: rationale
property.description: Provides a succinct statement of the need for the measure. Usually includes statements pertaining to importance criterion: impact, gap in care, and evidence.

property.name: clinicalRecommendationStatement
property.description: Provides a summary of relevant clinical guidelines or other clinical recommendations supporting the measure.

property.name: improvementNotation
property.description: Information on whether an increase or decrease in score is the preferred result (e.g., a higher score indicates better quality OR a lower score indicates better quality OR quality is within a range).

property.name: term
property.description: Provides a description of an individual term used within the measure.

property.name: guidance
property.description: Additional guidance for the measure including how it can be used in a clinical context, and the intent of the measure.

property.name: group
property.description: A group of population criteria for the measure.

property.name: supplementalData
property.description: The supplemental data criteria for the measure report, specified as either the name of a valid CQL expression within a referenced library, or a valid FHIR Resource Path.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: code
property.description: A codeable representation of the defined term.

property.name: definition
property.description: Provides a definition for the term as used within the measure.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: An identifier that is unique within the Measure allowing linkage to the equivalent item in a MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: Indicates a meaning for the group. This can be as simple as a unique identifier, or it can establish meaning in a broader context by drawing from a terminology, allowing groups to be correlated across measures.

property.name: description
property.description: The human readable description of this population group.

property.name: type
property.description: Indicates whether the measure is used to examine a process, an outcome over time, a patient-reported outcome, or a structure measure such as utilization.

property.name: subject
property.description: The intended subjects for the measure. If this element is not provided, a Patient subject is assumed, but the subject of the measure can be anything.

property.name: basis
property.description: The population basis specifies the type of elements in the population. For a subject-based measure, this is boolean (because the subject and the population basis are the same, and the population criteria define yes/no values for each individual in the population). For measures that have a population basis that is different than the subject, this element specifies the type of the population basis. For example, an encounter-based measure has a subject of Patient and a population basis of Encounter, and the population criteria all return lists of Encounters.

property.name: scoring
property.description: Indicates how the calculation is performed for the measure, including proportion, ratio, continuous-variable, and cohort. The value set is extensible, allowing additional measure scoring types to be represented.

property.name: scoringUnit
property.description: Defines the expected units of measure for the measure score. This element SHOULD be specified as a UCUM unit.

property.name: rateAggregation
property.description: Describes how to combine the information calculated, based on logic in each of several populations, into one summarized result.

property.name: improvementNotation
property.description: Information on whether an increase or decrease in score is the preferred result (e.g., a higher score indicates better quality OR a lower score indicates better quality OR quality is within a range).

property.name: library
property.description: A reference to a Library resource containing the formal logic used by the measure group.

property.name: population
property.description: A population criteria for the measure.

property.name: stratifier
property.description: The stratifier criteria for the measure report, specified as either the name of a valid CQL expression defined within a referenced library or a valid FHIR Resource Path.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: An identifier that is unique within the Measure allowing linkage to the equivalent population in a MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: The type of population criteria.

property.name: description
property.description: The human readable description of this population criteria.

property.name: criteria
property.description: An expression that specifies the criteria for the population, typically the name of an expression in a library.

property.name: groupDefinition
property.description: A Group resource that defines this population as a set of characteristics.

property.name: inputPopulationId
property.description: The id of a population element in this measure that provides the input for this population criteria. In most cases, the scoring structure of the measure implies specific relationships (e.g. the Numerator uses the Denominator as the source in a proportion scoring). In some cases, however, multiple possible choices exist and must be resolved explicitly. For example in a ratio measure with multiple initial populations, the denominator must specify which population should be used as the starting point.

property.name: aggregateMethod
property.description: Specifies which method should be used to aggregate measure observation values. For most scoring types, this is implied by scoring (e.g. a proportion measure counts members of the populations). For continuous variables, however, this information must be specified to ensure correct calculation.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: An identifier that is unique within the Measure allowing linkage to the equivalent item in a MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: Indicates a meaning for the stratifier. This can be as simple as a unique identifier, or it can establish meaning in a broader context by drawing from a terminology, allowing stratifiers to be correlated across measures.

property.name: description
property.description: The human readable description of this stratifier criteria.

property.name: criteria
property.description: An expression that specifies the criteria for the stratifier. This is typically the name of an expression defined within a referenced library, but it may also be a path to a stratifier element.

property.name: groupDefinition
property.description: A Group resource that defines this population as a set of characteristics.

property.name: component
property.description: A component of the stratifier criteria for the measure report, specified as either the name of a valid CQL expression defined within a referenced library or a valid FHIR Resource Path.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: An identifier that is unique within the Measure allowing linkage to the equivalent item in a MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: Indicates a meaning for the stratifier component. This can be as simple as a unique identifier, or it can establish meaning in a broader context by drawing from a terminology, allowing stratifiers to be correlated across measures.

property.name: description

property.name: criteria
property.description: An expression that specifies the criteria for this component of the stratifier. This is typically the name of an expression defined within a referenced library, but it may also be a path to a stratifier element.

property.name: groupDefinition

property.name: linkId
property.description: An identifier that is unique within the Measure allowing linkage to the equivalent item in a MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: Indicates a meaning for the supplemental data. This can be as simple as a unique identifier, or it can establish meaning in a broader context by drawing from a terminology, allowing supplemental data to be correlated across measures.

property.name: usage
property.description: An indicator of the intended usage for the supplemental data element. Supplemental data indicates the data is additional information requested to augment the measure information. Risk adjustment factor indicates the data is additional information used to calculate risk adjustment factors when applying a risk model to the measure calculation.

property.name: description
property.description: The human readable description of this supplemental data.

property.name: criteria
property.description: The criteria for the supplemental data. This is typically the name of a valid expression defined within a referenced library, but it may also be a path to a specific data element. The criteria defines the data to be returned for this element.

operation.name: care-gaps
operation.description: The care-gaps operation is used to determine gaps-in-care based on the results of quality measures

parameter.name: periodStart
parameter.description: The start of the measurement period. In keeping with the semantics of the date parameter used in the FHIR search operation, the period will start at the beginning of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period s

parameter.name: periodEnd
parameter.description: The end of the measurement period. The period will end at the end of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period end to be 2014-12-31T23:59:59 inclusive

parameter.name: topic
parameter.description: The topic to be used to determine which measures are considered for the care gaps report. Any measure with the given topic will be included in the report

parameter.name: subject
parameter.description: Subject for which the care gaps report will be produced

parameter.name: return
parameter.description: The result of the care gaps report will be returned as a document bundle with a MeasureReport entry for each included measure

operation.name: collect-data
operation.description: The collect-data operation is used to collect the data-of-interest for the given measure.

parameter.name: periodStart
parameter.description: The start of the measurement period. In keeping with the semantics of the date parameter used in the FHIR search operation, the period will start at the beginning of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period s

parameter.name: periodEnd
parameter.description: The end of the measurement period. The period will end at the end of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period end to be 2014-12-31T23:59:59 inclusive

parameter.name: measure
parameter.description: The measure to evaluate. This parameter is only required when the operation is invoked on the resource type, it is not used when invoking the operation on a Measure instance

parameter.name: subject
parameter.description: Subject for which the measure will be collected. If not specified, measure data will be collected for all subjects that meet the requirements of the measure. If specified, the measure will only be calculated for the referenced subject(s)

parameter.name: practitioner
parameter.description: Practitioner for which the measure will be collected. If specified, measure data will be collected only for subjects that have a primary relationship to the identified practitioner

parameter.name: lastReceivedOn
parameter.description: The date the results of this measure were last received. This parameter used to indicate when the last time data for this measure was collected. This information is used to support incremental data collection scenarios

parameter.name: measureReport
parameter.description: A MeasureReport of type data-exchange detailing the results of the operation

parameter.name: resource
parameter.description: The result resources that make up the data-of-interest for the measure

operation.name: data-requirements
operation.description: The data-requirements operation aggregates and returns the parameters and data requirements for the measure and all its dependencies as a single module definition

parameter.name: periodStart
parameter.description: The start of the measurement period. In keeping with the semantics of the date parameter used in the FHIR search operation, the period will start at the beginning of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period start to be 2014-01-01T00:00:00 inclusive

parameter.name: periodEnd
parameter.description: The end of the measurement period. The period will end at the end of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period end to be 2014-12-31T23:59:59 inclusive

parameter.name: return
parameter.description: The result of the requirements gathering is a module-definition Library that describes the aggregate parameters, data requirements, and dependencies of the measure

operation.name: evaluate-measure
operation.description: The evaluate-measure operation is used to calculate an eMeasure and obtain the results

parameter.name: measure
parameter.description: The measure to evaluate. If the operation is invoked at the instance level, this parameter is not allowed; if the operation is invoked at the type level, this parameter is required, or a url (and optionally version) must be supplied.

parameter.name: url
parameter.description: The url of the plan measure to be applied. If the operation is invoked at the instance level, this parameter is not allowed; if the operation is invoked at the type level, this parameter (and optionally the version), or the measure parameter must be supplied

parameter.name: version
parameter.description: The version of the measure to be applied. If the operation is invoked at the instance level, this parameter is not allowed; if the operation is invoked at the type level, this parameter may only be used if the url parameter is supplied.

parameter.name: subject
parameter.description: Subject for which the measure will be calculated. The subject may be a Patient, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, Location, Device, or Group. Subjects provided in this parameter will be resolved as the subject of the measure based on the type of the subject. If multiple subjects of the same type are provided, the behavior is implementation-defined

parameter.name: periodStart
parameter.description: The start of the measurement period. In keeping with the semantics of the date parameter used in the FHIR search operation, the period will start at the beginning of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period start to be 2014-01-01T00:00:00 inclusive

parameter.name: periodEnd
parameter.description: The end of the measurement period. The period will end at the end of the period implied by the supplied timestamp. E.g. a value of 2014 would set the period end to be 2014-12-31T23:59:59 inclusive

parameter.name: reportType
parameter.description: The type of measure report: individual, subject-list, or summary. If not specified, a default value of individual will be used if the subject parameter is supplied, otherwise, summary will be used. NOTE: Implementations should support the use of `subject` for individual and `population` for summary for backwards compatibility with existing implementations.

parameter.name: provider
parameter.description: The provider for which the report will be run. This may be a reference to a Practitioner, PractitionerRole, or Organization. If specified, the measure will be calculated for subjects that have a primary relationship to the identified provider. How this relationship is determined is implementation-specific.

parameter.name: location
parameter.description: The location for which the report will be run.

parameter.name: lastReceivedOn
parameter.description: The date the results of this measure were last received. This parameter is only valid for patient-level reports and is used to indicate when the last time a result for this patient was received. This information can be used to limit the set of resources returned for a patient-level report

parameter.name: parameters
parameter.description: Any input parameters for the evaluation. Parameters defined in this input will be made available by name to the CQL expression. Parameter types are mapped to CQL as specified in the Using CQL topic of the Clinical Reasoning Module. If a parameter appears more than once in the input Parameters resource, it is represented with a List in the input CQL. If a parameter has parts, it is represented as a Tuple in the input CQL.

parameter.name: return
parameter.description: The results of the measure calculation. The result of this operation will be a Bundle for each input subject, where the first entry of the Bundle is a MeasureReport representing the results of the calculation, and subsequent entries in the Bundle are resources created and/or evaluated as part of the calculation. See the MeasureReport resource for a complete description of the output of this operation. Note that implementations may choose to return a MeasureReport with a status of pending to indicate that the report is still being generated. In this case, the client can use a polling method to continually request the MeasureReport until the status is updated to complete

operation.name: submit-data
operation.description: The submit-data operation is used to submit data-of-interest for a measure. There is no expectation that the submitted data represents all the data-of-interest, only that all the data submitted is relevant to the calculation of the measure for a particular subject or population

parameter.name: measureReport
parameter.description: The measure report being submitted

parameter.name: resource
parameter.description: The individual resources that make up the data-of-interest being submitted

resource.name: MeasureReport
resource.description: The MeasureReport resource contains the results of the calculation of a measure; and optionally a reference to the resources involved in that calculation.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: A formal identifier that is used to identify this MeasureReport when it is represented in other formats or referenced in a specification, model, design or an instance.

property.name: status
property.description: The MeasureReport status. No data will be available until the MeasureReport status is complete.

property.name: type
property.description: The type of measure report. This may be an individual report, which provides the score for the measure for an individual member of the population; a subject-listing, which returns the list of members that meet the various criteria in the measure; a summary report, which returns a population count for each of the criteria in the measure; or a data-collection, which enables the MeasureReport to be used to exchange the data-of-interest for a quality measure.

property.name: dataUpdateType
property.description: Indicates whether the data submitted in a data-exchange report represents a snapshot or incremental update. A snapshot update replaces all previously submitted data for the receiver, whereas an incremental update represents only updated and/or changed data and should be applied as a differential update to the existing submitted data for the receiver.

property.name: measure
property.description: A reference to the Measure that was calculated to produce this report.

property.name: subject
property.description: Optional subject identifying the individual or individuals the report is for.

property.name: date
property.description: The date this measure was calculated.

property.name: reporter
property.description: The individual or organization that is reporting the data.

property.name: reportingVendor
property.description: A reference to the vendor who queried the data, calculated results and/or generated the report. The reporting vendor is intended to represent the submitting entity when it is not the same as the reporting entity. This extension is used when the Receiver is interested in getting vendor information in the report.

property.name: location
property.description: A reference to the location for which the data is being reported.

property.name: period
property.description: The reporting period for which the report was calculated.

property.name: inputParameters
property.description: A reference to a Parameters resource (typically represented using a contained resource) that represents any input parameters that were provided to the operation that generated the report.

property.name: scoring
property.description: Indicates how the calculation is performed for the measure, including proportion, ratio, continuous-variable, and cohort. The value set is extensible, allowing additional measure scoring types to be represented. It is expected to be the same as the scoring element on the referenced Measure.

property.name: improvementNotation
property.description: Whether improvement in the measure is noted by an increase or decrease in the measure score.

property.name: group
property.description: The results of the calculation, one for each population group in the measure.

property.name: supplementalData
property.description: A reference to a Resource that represents additional information collected for the report. If the value of the supplemental data is not a Resource (i.e. evaluating the supplementalData expression for this case in the measure results in a value that is not a FHIR Resource), it is reported as a reference to a contained Observation resource.

property.name: evaluatedResource
property.description: Evaluated resources are used to capture what data was involved in the calculation of a measure. This usage is only allowed for individual reports to ensure that the size of the MeasureReport resource is bounded.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: The group from the Measure that corresponds to this group in the MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: The meaning of the population group as defined in the measure definition.

property.name: subject
property.description: Optional subject identifying the individual or individuals the report is for.

property.name: population
property.description: The populations that make up the population group, one for each type of population appropriate for the measure.

property.name: measureScore
property.description: The measure score for this population group, calculated as appropriate for the measure type and scoring method, and based on the contents of the populations defined in the group.

property.name: stratifier
property.description: When a measure includes multiple stratifiers, there will be a stratifier group for each stratifier defined by the measure.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: The population from the Measure that corresponds to this population in the MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: The type of the population.

property.name: count
property.description: The number of members of the population.

property.name: subjectResults
property.description: This element refers to a List of individual level MeasureReport resources, one for each subject in this population.

property.name: subjectReport
property.description: A reference to an individual level MeasureReport resource for a member of the population.

property.name: subjects
property.description: Optional Group identifying the individuals that make up the population.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: The stratifier from the Measure that corresponds to this stratifier in the MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: The meaning of this stratifier, as defined in the measure definition.

property.name: stratum
property.description: This element contains the results for a single stratum within the stratifier. For example, when stratifying on administrative gender, there will be four strata, one for each possible gender value.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: value
property.description: The value for this stratum, expressed as a CodeableConcept. When defining stratifiers on complex values, the value must be rendered such that the value for each stratum within the stratifier is unique.

property.name: component
property.description: A stratifier component value.

property.name: population
property.description: The populations that make up the stratum, one for each type of population appropriate to the measure.

property.name: measureScore
property.description: The measure score for this stratum, calculated as appropriate for the measure type and scoring method, and based on only the members of this stratum.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: The stratifier component from the Measure that corresponds to this stratifier component in the MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: The code for the stratum component value.

property.name: value
property.description: The stratum component value.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: linkId
property.description: The population from the Measure that corresponds to this population in the MeasureReport resource.

property.name: code
property.description: The type of the population.

property.name: count
property.description: The number of members of the population in this stratum.

property.name: subjectResults
property.description: This element refers to a List of individual level MeasureReport resources, one for each subject in this population in this stratum.

property.name: subjectReport
property.description: A reference to an individual level MeasureReport resource for a member of the population.

property.name: subjects
property.description: Optional Group identifying the individuals that make up the population.

codeset.name: MeasureReportStatus
codeset.description: The status of the measure report.

code.name: Complete
code.description: The report is complete and ready for use.

code.name: Pending
code.description: The report is currently being generated.

code.name: Error
code.description: An error occurred attempting to generate the report.

codeset.name: MeasureReportType
codeset.description: The type of the measure report.

code.name: Individual
code.description: An individual report that provides information on the performance for a given measure with respect to a single subject.

code.name: SubjectList
code.description: A subject list report that includes a listing of subjects that satisfied each population criteria in the measure.

code.name: Summary
code.description: A summary report that returns the number of members in each population criteria for the measure.

code.name: DataExchange
code.description: A data exchange report that contains data-of-interest for the measure (i.e. data that is needed to calculate the measure)

codeset.name: SubmitDataUpdateType
codeset.description: Concepts for how a measure report consumer and receiver coordinate data exchange updates. The choices are snapshot or incremental updates

code.name: Incremental
code.description: In contrast to the Snapshot Update, the FHIR Parameters resource used in a Submit Data or the Collect Data scenario contains only the new and updated DEQM and QI Core Profiles since the last transaction. If the Consumer supports incremental updates, the contents of the updated payload updates the previous payload data.

code.name: Snapshot
code.description: In contrast to the Incremental Update, the FHIR Parameters resource used in a Submit Data or the Collect Data scenario contains all the DEQM and QI Core Profiles for each transaction. If the Consumer supports snapshot updates, the contents of the updated payload entirely replaces the previous payload

resource.name: Medication
resource.description: This resource is primarily used for the identification and definition of a medication, including ingredients, for the purposes of prescribing, dispensing, and administering a medication as well as for making statements about medication use.

property.name: id
property.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource. Once assigned, this value never changes.

property.name: meta
property.description: The metadata about the resource. This is content that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

property.name: implicitRules
property.description: A reference to a set of rules that were followed when the resource was constructed, and which must be understood when processing the content. Often, this is a reference to an implementation guide that defines the special rules along with other profiles etc.

property.name: language
property.description: The base language in which the resource is written.

property.name: text
property.description: A human-readable narrative that contains a summary of the resource and can be used to represent the content of the resource to a human. The narrative need not encode all the structured data, but is required to contain sufficient detail to make it "clinically safe" for a human to just read the narrative. Resource definitions may define what content should be represented in the narrative to ensure clinical safety.

property.name: identifier
property.description: Business identifier for this medication.

property.name: code
property.description: A code (or set of codes) that specify this medication, or a textual description if no code is available. Usage note: This could be a standard medication code such as a code from RxNorm, SNOMED CT, IDMP etc. It could also be a national or local formulary code, optionally with translations to other code systems.

property.name: status
property.description: A code to indicate if the medication is in active use.

property.name: marketingAuthorizationHolder
property.description: The company or other legal entity that has authorization, from the appropriate drug regulatory authority, to market a medicine in one or more jurisdictions. Typically abbreviated MAH.Note: The MAH may manufacture the product and may also contract the manufacturing of the product to one or more companies (organizations).

property.name: doseForm
property.description: Describes the form of the item. Powder; tablets; capsule.

property.name: totalVolume
property.description: When the specified product code does not infer a package size, this is the specific amount of drug in the product. For example, when specifying a product that has the same strength (For example, Insulin glargine 100 unit per mL solution for injection), this attribute provides additional clarification of the package amount (For example, 3 mL, 10mL, etc.).

property.name: ingredient
property.description: Identifies a particular constituent of interest in the product.

property.name: batch
property.description: Information that only applies to packages (not products).

property.name: definition
property.description: A reference to a knowledge resource that provides more information about this medication.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: item
property.description: The ingredient (substance or medication) that the ingredient.strength relates to. This is represented as a concept from a code system or described in another resource (Substance or Medication).

property.name: isActive
property.description: Indication of whether this ingredient affects the therapeutic action of the drug.

property.name: strength
property.description: Specifies how many (or how much) of the items there are in this Medication. For example, 250 mg per tablet. This is expressed as a ratio where the numerator is 250mg and the denominator is 1 tablet but can also be expressed a quantity when the denominator is assumed to be 1 tablet.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: lotNumber
property.description: The assigned lot number of a batch of the specified product.

property.name: expirationDate
property.description: When this specific batch of product will expire.

resource.name: MedicationAdministration
resource.description: Describes the event of a patient consuming or otherwise being administered a medication. This may be as simple as swallowing a tablet or it may be a long running infusion. Related resources tie this event to the authorizing prescription, and the specific encounter between patient and health care practitioner.
