property.name: lastUpdated
property.description: When the resource last changed - e.g. when the version changed.

property.name: source

This provides a minimal amount of [Provenance](provenance.html#) information that can be used to track or differentiate the source of information in the resource. The source may identify another FHIR server, document, message, database, etc.

property.name: profile
property.description: A list of profiles (references to [StructureDefinition](structuredefinition.html#) resources) that this resource claims to conform to. The URL is a reference to [StructureDefinition.url](structuredefinition-definitions.html#StructureDefinition.url).

property.name: security
property.description: Security labels applied to this resource. These tags connect specific resources to the overall security policy and infrastructure.

property.name: tag
property.description: Tags applied to this resource. Tags are intended to be used to identify and relate resources to process and workflow, and applications are not required to consider the tags when interpreting the meaning of a resource.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: base | surcharge | deduction | discount | tax | informational.

property.name: code
property.description: Codes may be used to differentiate between kinds of taxes, surcharges, discounts etc.

property.name: factor
property.description: Factor used for calculating this component.

property.name: amount
property.description: Explicit value amount to be used.

codeset.name: PriceComponentType
codeset.description: Codes indicating the kind of the price component.

code.name: Base
code.description: the amount is the base price used for calculating the total price before applying surcharges, discount or taxes.

code.name: Surcharge
code.description: the amount is a surcharge applied on the base price.

code.name: Deduction
code.description: the amount is a deduction applied on the base price.

code.name: Discount
code.description: the amount is a discount applied on the base price.

code.name: Tax
code.description: the amount is the tax component of the total price.

code.name: Informational
code.description: the amount is of informational character, it has not been applied in the calculation of the total price.

element.name: Money
element.description: An amount of economic utility in some recognized currency.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: value
property.description: Numerical value (with implicit precision).

property.name: currency
property.description: ISO 4217 Currency Code.

element.name: Narrative
element.description: A human-readable summary of the resource conveying the essential clinical and business information for the resource.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: status
property.description: The status of the narrative - whether its entirely generated (from just the defined data or the extensions too), or whether a human authored it and it may contain additional data.

property.name: div
property.description: The actual narrative content, a stripped down version of XHTML.

codeset.name: NarrativeStatus
codeset.description: The status of a resource narrative.

code.name: Generated
code.description: The contents of the narrative are entirely generated from the core elements in the content.

code.name: Extensions
code.description: The contents of the narrative are entirely generated from the core elements in the content and some of the content is generated from extensions. The narrative SHALL reflect the impact of all modifier extensions.

code.name: Additional
code.description: The contents of the narrative may contain additional information not found in the structured data. Note that there is no computable way to determine what the extra information is, other than by human inspection.

code.name: Empty
code.description: The contents of the narrative are some equivalent of "No human-readable text provided in this case".

element.name: ParameterDefinition

property.name: id

property.name: use
property.description: Whether the parameter is input or output for the module.

property.name: min
property.description: The minimum number of times this parameter SHALL appear in the request or response.

property.name: max
property.description: The maximum number of times this element is permitted to appear in the request or response.

property.name: documentation
property.description: A brief discussion of what the parameter is for and how it is used by the module.

property.name: type
property.description: The type of the parameter.

property.name: profile
property.description: If specified, this indicates a profile that the input data must conform to, or that the output data will conform to.

element.name: Period
element.description: A time period defined by a start and end date and optionally time.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: start
property.description: The start of the period. The boundary is inclusive.

property.name: end
property.description: The end of the period. If the end of the period is missing, it means no end was known or planned at the time the instance was created. The start may be in the past, and the end date in the future, which means that period is expected/planned to end at that time.

element.name: ProductShelfLife
element.description: The shelf-life and storage information for a medicinal product item or container can be described using this class.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: This describes the shelf life, taking into account various scenarios such as shelf life of the packaged Medicinal Product itself, shelf life after transformation where necessary and shelf life after the first opening of a bottle, etc. The shelf life type shall be specified using an appropriate controlled vocabulary The controlled term and the controlled term identifier shall be specified.

property.name: period
property.description: The shelf life time period can be specified using a numerical value for the period of time and its unit of time measurement The unit of measurement shall be specified in accordance with ISO 11240 and the resulting terminology The symbol and the symbol identifier shall be used.

property.name: specialPrecautionsForStorage
property.description: Special precautions for storage, if any, can be specified using an appropriate controlled vocabulary The controlled term and the controlled term identifier shall be specified.

element.name: Quantity
element.description: A measured amount (or an amount that can potentially be measured). Note that measured amounts include amounts that are not precisely quantified, including amounts involving arbitrary units and floating currencies.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: value

property.name: comparator
property.description: How the value should be understood and represented - whether the actual value is greater or less than the stated value due to measurement issues; e.g. if the comparator is "lower than" , then the real value is lower than stated value.

property.name: unit
property.description: A human-readable form of the unit.

property.name: system
property.description: The identification of the system that provides the coded form of the unit.

property.name: code
property.description: A computer processable form of the unit in some unit representation system.

element.name: Range

property.name: high

element.name: Ratio

property.name: numerator

property.name: denominator
property.description: The value of the denominator.

element.name: RatioRange

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: lowNumerator
property.description: The value of the low limit numerator.

property.name: highNumerator
property.description: The value of the high limit numerator.

property.name: denominator
property.description: The value of the denominator.

element.name: Reference
element.description: A reference from one resource to another.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: reference
property.description: A reference to a location at which the other resource is found. The reference may be a relative reference, in which case it is relative to the service base URL, or an absolute URL that resolves to the location where the resource is found. The reference may be version specific or not. If the reference is not to a FHIR RESTful server, then it should be assumed to be version specific. Internal fragment references (start with #) refer to contained resources.

property.name: type
property.description: The expected type of the target of the reference. If both Reference.type and Reference.reference are populated and Reference.reference is a FHIR URL, both SHALL be consistent.The type is the Canonical URL of Resource Definition that is the type this reference refers to. References are URLs that are relative to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ e.g. "Patient" is a reference to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient. Absolute URLs are only allowed for logical models (and can only be used in references in logical models, not resources).

property.name: identifier
property.description: An identifier for the target resource. This is used when there is no way to reference the other resource directly, either because the entity it represents is not available through a FHIR server, or because there is no way for the author of the resource to convert a known identifier to an actual location. There is no requirement that a Reference.identifier point to something that is actually exposed as a FHIR instance, but it SHALL point to a business concept that would be expected to be exposed as a FHIR instance, and that instance would need to be of a FHIR resource type allowed by the reference.

property.name: display
property.description: Plain text narrative that identifies the resource in addition to the resource reference.

element.name: RelatedArtifact
element.description: Related artifacts such as additional documentation, justification, or bibliographic references.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: The type of relationship to the related artifact.

property.name: classifier
property.description: Provides additional classifiers of the related artifact.

property.name: label
property.description: A short label that can be used to reference the citation from elsewhere in the containing artifact, such as a footnote index.

property.name: display
property.description: A brief description of the document or knowledge resource being referenced, suitable for display to a consumer.

property.name: citation
property.description: A bibliographic citation for the related artifact. This text SHOULD be formatted according to an accepted citation format.

property.name: document
property.description: The document being referenced, represented as an attachment. This is exclusive with the resource element.

property.name: resource
property.description: The related artifact, such as a library, value set, profile, or other knowledge resource.

property.name: resourceReference
property.description: The related artifact, if the artifact is not a canonical resource, or a resource reference to a canonical resource.

property.name: publicationStatus
property.description: The publication status of the artifact being referred to.

property.name: publicationDate
property.description: The date of publication of the artifact being referred to.

codeset.name: RelatedArtifactType
codeset.description: The type of relationship to the related artifact.

code.name: Documentation
code.description: Additional documentation for the knowledge resource. This would include additional instructions on usage as well as additional information on clinical context or appropriateness.

code.name: Justification
code.description: The target artifact is a summary of the justification for the knowledge resource including supporting evidence, relevant guidelines, or other clinically important information. This information is intended to provide a way to make the justification for the knowledge resource available to the consumer of interventions or results produced by the knowledge resource.

code.name: Citation
code.description: Bibliographic citation for papers, references, or other relevant material for the knowledge resource. This is intended to allow for citation of related material, but that was not necessarily specifically prepared in connection with this knowledge resource.

code.name: Predecessor
code.description: The previous version of the knowledge artifact, used to establish an ordering of versions of an artifact, independent of the status of each version.

code.name: Successor
code.description: The subsequent version of the knowledge artfact, used to establish an ordering of versions of an artifact, independent of the status of each version.

code.name: DerivedFrom
code.description: This artifact is derived from the target artifact. This is intended to capture the relationship in which a particular knowledge resource is based on the content of another artifact, but is modified to capture either a different set of overall requirements, or a more specific set of requirements such as those involved in a particular institution or clinical setting. The artifact may be derived from one or more target artifacts.

code.name: DependsOn
code.description: This artifact depends on the target artifact. There is a requirement to use the target artifact in the creation or interpretation of this artifact.

code.name: ComposedOf
code.description: This artifact is composed of the target artifact. This artifact is constructed with the target artifact as a component. The target artifact is a part of this artifact. (A dataset is composed of data.).

code.name: PartOf
code.description: This artifact is a part of the target artifact. The target artifact is composed of this artifact (and possibly other artifacts).

code.name: Amends
code.description: This artifact amends or changes the target artifact. This artifact adds additional information that is functionally expected to replace information in the target artifact. This artifact replaces a part but not all of the target artifact.

code.name: AmendedWith
code.description: This artifact is amended with or changed by the target artifact. There is information in this artifact that should be functionally replaced with information in the target artifact.

code.name: Appends
code.description: This artifact adds additional information to the target artifact. The additional information does not replace or change information in the target artifact.

code.name: AppendedWith
code.description: This artifact has additional information in the target artifact.

code.name: Cites
code.description: This artifact cites the target artifact. This may be a bibliographic citation for papers, references, or other relevant material for the knowledge resource. This is intended to allow for citation of related material, but that was not necessarily specifically prepared in connection with this knowledge resource.

code.name: CitedBy
code.description: This artifact is cited by the target artifact.

code.name: CommentsOn
code.description: This artifact contains comments about the target artifact.

code.name: CommentIn
code.description: This artifact has comments about it in the target artifact. The type of comments may be expressed in the targetClassifier element such as reply, review, editorial, feedback, solicited, unsolicited, structured, unstructured.

code.name: Contains
code.description: This artifact is a container in which the target artifact is contained. A container is a data structure whose instances are collections of other objects. (A database contains the dataset.).

code.name: ContainedIn
code.description: This artifact is contained in the target artifact. The target artifact is a data structure whose instances are collections of other objects.

code.name: Corrects
code.description: This artifact identifies errors and replacement content for the target artifact.

code.name: CorrectionIn
code.description: This artifact has corrections to it in the target artifact. The target artifact identifies errors and replacement content for this artifact.

code.name: Replaces
code.description: This artifact replaces or supersedes the target artifact. The target artifact may be considered deprecated.

code.name: ReplacedWith
code.description: This artifact is replaced with or superseded by the target artifact. This artifact may be considered deprecated.

code.name: Retracts
code.description: This artifact retracts the target artifact. The content that was published in the target artifact should be considered removed from publication and should no longer be considered part of the public record.

code.name: RetractedBy
code.description: This artifact is retracted by the target artifact. The content that was published in this artifact should be considered removed from publication and should no longer be considered part of the public record.

code.name: Signs
code.description: This artifact is a signature of the target artifact.

code.name: SimilarTo
code.description: This artifact has characteristics in common with the target artifact. This relationship may be used in systems to deduplicate knowledge artifacts from different sources, or in systems to show similar items.

code.name: Supports
code.description: This artifact provides additional support for the target artifact. The type of support is not documentation as it does not describe, explain, or instruct regarding the target artifact.

code.name: SupportedWith
code.description: The target artifact contains additional information related to the knowledge artifact but is not documentation as the additional information does not describe, explain, or instruct regarding the knowledge artifact content or application. This could include an associated dataset.

code.name: Transforms
code.description: This artifact was generated by transforming the target artifact (e.g., format or language conversion). This is intended to capture the relationship in which a particular knowledge resource is based on the content of another artifact, but changes are only apparent in form and there is only one target artifact with the transforms relationship type.

code.name: TransformedInto
code.description: This artifact was transformed into the target artifact (e.g., by format or language conversion).

code.name: TransformedWith
code.description: This artifact was generated by transforming a related artifact (e.g., format or language conversion), noted separately with the transforms relationship type. This transformation used the target artifact to inform the transformation. The target artifact may be a conversion script or translation guide.

code.name: Documents
code.description: This artifact provides additional documentation for the target artifact. This could include additional instructions on usage as well as additional information on clinical context or appropriateness.

code.name: SpecificationOf
code.description: The target artifact is a precise description of a concept in this artifact. This may be used when the RelatedArtifact datatype is used in elements contained in this artifact.

code.name: CreatedWith
code.description: This artifact was created with the target artifact. The target artifact is a tool or support material used in the creation of the artifact, and not content that the artifact was derived from.

code.name: CiteAs
code.description: The related artifact is the citation for this artifact.

element.name: SampledData
element.description: A series of measurements taken by a device, with upper and lower limits. There may be more than one dimension in the data.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: origin
property.description: The base quantity that a measured value of zero represents. In addition, this provides the units of the entire measurement series.

property.name: interval
property.description: Amount of intervalUnits between samples, e.g. milliseconds for time-based sampling.

property.name: intervalUnit
property.description: The measurement unit in which the sample interval is expressed.

property.name: factor
property.description: A correction factor that is applied to the sampled data points before they are added to the origin.

property.name: lowerLimit
property.description: The lower limit of detection of the measured points. This is needed if any of the data points have the value "L" (lower than detection limit).

property.name: upperLimit
property.description: The upper limit of detection of the measured points. This is needed if any of the data points have the value "U" (higher than detection limit).

property.name: dimensions
property.description: The number of sample points at each time point. If this value is greater than one, then the dimensions will be interlaced - all the sample points for a point in time will be recorded at once.

property.name: codeMap
property.description: Reference to ConceptMap that defines the codes used in the data.

property.name: offsets
property.description: A series of data points which are decimal values separated by a single space (character u20). The units in which the offsets are expressed are found in intervalUnit. The absolute point at which the measurements begin SHALL be conveyed outside the scope of this datatype, e.g. Observation.effectiveDateTime for a timing offset.

property.name: data
property.description: A series of data points which are decimal values or codes separated by a single space (character u20). The special codes "E" (error), "L" (below detection limit) and "U" (above detection limit) are also defined for used in place of decimal values.

element.name: Signature
element.description: A signature along with supporting context. The signature may be a digital signature that is cryptographic in nature, or some other signature acceptable to the domain. This other signature may be as simple as a graphical image representing a hand-written signature, or a signature ceremony Different signature approaches have different utilities.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: An indication of the reason that the entity signed this document. This may be explicitly included as part of the signature information and can be used when determining accountability for various actions concerning the document.

property.name: when
property.description: When the digital signature was signed.

property.name: who
property.description: A reference to an application-usable description of the identity that signed (e.g. the signature used their private key).

property.name: onBehalfOf
property.description: A reference to an application-usable description of the identity that is represented by the signature.

property.name: targetFormat
property.description: A mime type that indicates the technical format of the target resources signed by the signature.

property.name: sigFormat
property.description: A mime type that indicates the technical format of the signature. Important mime types are application/signature+xml for X ML DigSig, application/jose for JWS, and image/* for a graphical image of a signature, etc.

property.name: data
property.description: The base64 encoding of the Signature content. When signature is not recorded electronically this element would be empty.

element.name: Timing
element.description: Specifies an event that may occur multiple times. Timing schedules are used to record when things are planned, expected or requested to occur. The most common usage is in dosage instructions for medications. They are also used when planning care of various kinds, and may be used for reporting the schedule to which past regular activities were carried out.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: event
property.description: Identifies specific times when the event occurs.

property.name: repeat
property.description: A set of rules that describe when the event is scheduled.

property.name: code
property.description: A code for the timing schedule (or just text in code.text). Some codes such as BID are ubiquitous, but many institutions define their own additional codes. If a code is provided, the code is understood to be a complete statement of whatever is specified in the structured timing data, and either the code or the data may be used to interpret the Timing, with the exception that .repeat.bounds still applies over the code (and is not contained in the code).

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: bounds
property.description: Either a duration for the length of the timing schedule, a range of possible length, or outer bounds for start and/or end limits of the timing schedule.

property.name: count
property.description: A total count of the desired number of repetitions across the duration of the entire timing specification. If countMax is present, this element indicates the lower bound of the allowed range of count values.

property.name: countMax
property.description: If present, indicates that the count is a range - so to perform the action between [count] and [countMax] times.

property.name: duration
property.description: How long this thing happens for when it happens. If durationMax is present, this element indicates the lower bound of the allowed range of the duration.

property.name: durationMax
property.description: If present, indicates that the duration is a range - so to perform the action between [duration] and [durationMax] time length.

property.name: durationUnit
property.description: The units of time for the duration, in UCUM unitsNormal practice is to use the mo code as a calendar month when calculating the next occurrence.

property.name: frequency
property.description: The number of times to repeat the action within the specified period. If frequencyMax is present, this element indicates the lower bound of the allowed range of the frequency.

property.name: frequencyMax
property.description: If present, indicates that the frequency is a range - so to repeat between [frequency] and [frequencyMax] times within the period or period range.

property.name: period
property.description: Indicates the duration of time over which repetitions are to occur; e.g. to express "3 times per day", 3 would be the frequency and "1 day" would be the period. If periodMax is present, this element indicates the lower bound of the allowed range of the period length.

property.name: periodMax
property.description: If present, indicates that the period is a range from [period] to [periodMax], allowing expressing concepts such as "do this once every 3-5 days.

property.name: periodUnit
property.description: The units of time for the period in UCUM unitsNormal practice is to use the mo code as a calendar month when calculating the next occurrence.

property.name: dayOfWeek
property.description: If one or more days of week is provided, then the action happens only on the specified day(s).

property.name: timeOfDay
property.description: Specified time of day for action to take place.

property.name: when
property.description: An approximate time period during the day, potentially linked to an event of daily living that indicates when the action should occur.

property.name: offset
property.description: The number of minutes from the event. If the event code does not indicate whether the minutes is before or after the event, then the offset is assumed to be after the event.

codeset.name: UnitsOfTime
codeset.description: A unit of time (units from UCUM).

code.name: S
code.description: second

code.name: Min
code.description: minute

code.name: H
code.description: hour

code.name: D
code.description: day

code.name: Wk
code.description: week

code.name: Mo
code.description: month - Normal practice is to use the mo code as a calendar month when calculating the next occurrence.

code.name: A
code.description: year

codeset.name: EventTiming
codeset.description: Real-world event relating to the schedule.

code.name: MORN
code.description: Event occurs during the morning. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: MORN_early
code.description: Event occurs during the early morning. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: MORN_late
code.description: Event occurs during the late morning. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: NOON
code.description: Event occurs around 12:00pm. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: AFT
code.description: Event occurs during the afternoon. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: AFT_early
code.description: Event occurs during the early afternoon. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: AFT_late
code.description: Event occurs during the late afternoon. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: EVE
code.description: Event occurs during the evening. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: EVE_early
code.description: Event occurs during the early evening. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: EVE_late
code.description: Event occurs during the late evening. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: NIGHT
code.description: Event occurs during the night. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: PHS
code.description: Event occurs [offset] after subject goes to sleep. The exact time is unspecified and established by institution convention or patient interpretation.

code.name: IMD
code.description: Event occurs a single time (with no repetitions) as soon as possible after the scheduled or actual start of the overall event.

code.name: HS
code.description: event occurs [offset] before the hour of sleep (or trying to)

code.name: WAKE
code.description: event occurs [offset] after waking

code.name: C
code.description: event occurs at a meal (from the Latin cibus)

code.name: CM
code.description: event occurs at breakfast (from the Latin cibus matutinus)

code.name: CD
code.description: event occurs at lunch (from the Latin cibus diurnus)

code.name: CV
code.description: event occurs at dinner (from the Latin ante cibus vespertinus)

code.name: AC
code.description: event occurs [offset] before a meal (from the Latin ante cibus)

code.name: ACM
code.description: event occurs [offset] before breakfast (from the Latin ante cibus matutinus)

code.name: ACD
code.description: event occurs [offset] before lunch (from the Latin ante cibus diurnus)

code.name: ACV
code.description: event occurs [offset] before dinner (from the Latin ante cibus vespertinus)

code.name: PC
code.description: event occurs [offset] after a meal (from the Latin post cibus)

code.name: PCM
code.description: event occurs [offset] after breakfast (from the Latin post cibus matutinus)

code.name: PCD
code.description: event occurs [offset] after lunch (from the Latin post cibus diurnus)

code.name: PCV
code.description: event occurs [offset] after dinner (from the Latin post cibus vespertinus)

element.name: TriggerDefinition
element.description: A description of a triggering event. Triggering events can be named events, data events, or periodic, as determined by the type element.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: type
property.description: The type of triggering event.

property.name: name
property.description: A formal name for the event. This may be an absolute URI that identifies the event formally (e.g. from a trigger registry), or a simple relative URI that identifies the event in a local context.

property.name: code
property.description: A code that identifies the event.

property.name: subscriptionTopic
property.description: A reference to a SubscriptionTopic resource that defines the event. If this element is provided, no other information about the trigger definition may be supplied.

property.name: timing
property.description: The timing of the event (if this is a periodic trigger).

property.name: data
property.description: The triggering data of the event (if this is a data trigger). If more than one data is requirement is specified, then all the data requirements must be true.

property.name: condition
property.description: A boolean-valued expression that is evaluated in the context of the container of the trigger definition and returns whether or not the trigger fires.

codeset.name: TriggerType
codeset.description: The type of trigger.

code.name: NamedEvent
code.description: The trigger occurs in response to a specific named event, and no other information about the trigger is specified. Named events are completely pre-coordinated, and the formal semantics of the trigger are not provided.

code.name: Periodic
code.description: The trigger occurs at a specific time or periodically as described by a timing or schedule. A periodic event cannot have any data elements, but may have a name assigned as a shorthand for the event.

code.name: DataChanged
code.description: The trigger occurs whenever data of a particular type is changed in any way, either added, modified, or removed.

code.name: DataAdded
code.description: The trigger occurs whenever data of a particular type is added.

code.name: DataModified
code.description: The trigger occurs whenever data of a particular type is modified.

code.name: DataRemoved
code.description: The trigger occurs whenever data of a particular type is removed.

code.name: DataAccessed
code.description: The trigger occurs whenever data of a particular type is accessed.

code.name: DataAccessEnded
code.description: The trigger occurs whenever access to data of a particular type is completed.

element.name: UsageContext
element.description: Specifies clinical/business/etc. metadata that can be used to retrieve, index and/or categorize an artifact. This metadata can either be specific to the applicable population (e.g., age category, DRG) or the specific context of care (e.g., venue, care setting, provider of care).

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: code
property.description: A code that identifies the type of context being specified by this usage context.

property.name: value
property.description: A value that defines the context specified in this context of use. The interpretation of the value is defined by the code.

property.name: id
property.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

property.name: channelType
property.description: The type of virtual service to connect to (i.e. Teams, Zoom, Specific VMR technology, WhatsApp).

property.name: address
property.description: What address or number needs to be used for a user to connect to the virtual service to join. The channelType informs as to which datatype is appropriate to use (requires knowledge of the specific type).

property.name: additionalInfo
property.description: Address to see alternative connection details.

property.name: maxParticipants
property.description: Maximum number of participants supported by the virtual service.

property.name: sessionKey
property.description: Session Key required by the virtual service.

codeset.name: PublicationStatus
codeset.description: The lifecycle status of an artifact.

code.name: Draft
code.description: This resource is still under development and is not yet considered to be ready for normal use.

code.name: Active
code.description: This resource is ready for normal use.

code.name: Retired
code.description: This resource has been withdrawn or superseded and should no longer be used.

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The authoring system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this resource. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, its just not known which one.

codeset.name: RequestIntent
codeset.description: Codes indicating the degree of authority/intentionality associated with a request.

code.name: Proposal
code.description: The request is a suggestion made by someone/something that does not have an intention to ensure it occurs and without providing an authorization to act.

code.name: Plan
code.description: The request represents an intention to ensure something occurs without providing an authorization for others to act.

code.name: Directive
code.description: The request represents a legally binding instruction authored by a Patient or RelatedPerson.

code.name: Order
code.description: The request represents a request/demand and authorization for action by the requestor.

code.name: OriginalOrder
code.description: The request represents an original authorization for action.

code.name: ReflexOrder
code.description: The request represents an automatically generated supplemental authorization for action based on a parent authorization together with initial results of the action taken against that parent authorization.

code.name: FillerOrder
code.description: The request represents the view of an authorization instantiated by a fulfilling system representing the details of the fulfillers intention to act upon a submitted order.

code.name: InstanceOrder
code.description: An order created in fulfillment of a broader order that represents the authorization for a single activity occurrence. E.g. The administration of a single dose of a drug.

code.name: Option
code.description: The request represents a component or option for a RequestOrchestration that establishes timing, conditionality and/or other constraints among a set of requests. Refer to [[[RequestOrchestration]]] for additional information on how this status is used.

codeset.name: RequestPriority
codeset.description: Identifies the level of importance to be assigned to actioning the request.

code.name: Routine
code.description: The request has normal priority.

code.name: Urgent
code.description: The request should be actioned promptly - higher priority than routine.

code.name: Asap
code.description: The request should be actioned as soon as possible - higher priority than urgent.

code.name: Stat
code.description: The request should be actioned immediately - highest possible priority. E.g. an emergency.

codeset.name: ActionParticipantType
codeset.description: The type of participant for the action.

code.name: Careteam
code.description: The participant is a care team caring for the patient under evaluation.

code.name: Device
code.description: The participant is a system or device used in the care of the patient.

code.name: Group
code.description: The participant is a group of participants involved in the care of the patient.

code.name: Healthcareservice
code.description: The participant is an institution that can provide the given healthcare service used in the care of the patient.

code.name: Location
code.description: The participant is a location involved in the care of the patient.

code.name: Organization
code.description: The participant is an organization involved in the care of the patient.

code.name: Patient
code.description: The participant is the patient under evaluation.

code.name: Practitioner
code.description: The participant is a practitioner involved in the patients care.

code.name: Practitionerrole
code.description: The participant is a particular practitioner role involved in the patients care.

code.name: Relatedperson
code.description: The participant is a person related to the patient.

codeset.name: ExampleScenarioActorType
codeset.description: The type of actor - system or human.

code.name: Person
code.description: A human actor

code.name: System
code.description: A software application or other system

codeset.name: ParticipationStatus
codeset.description: The Participation status of an appointment.

code.name: Accepted
code.description: The participant has accepted the appointment.

code.name: Declined
code.description: The participant has declined the appointment and will not participate in the appointment.

code.name: Tentative
code.description: The participant has tentatively accepted the appointment. This could be automatically created by a system and requires further processing before it can be accepted. There is no commitment that attendance will occur.

code.name: NeedsAction
code.description: The participant needs to indicate if they accept the appointment by changing this status to one of the other statuses.

codeset.name: CapabilityStatementKind
codeset.description: How a capability statement is intended to be used.

code.name: Instance
code.description: The CapabilityStatement instance represents the present capabilities of a specific system instance. This is the kind returned by /metadata for a FHIR server end-point.

code.name: Capability
code.description: The CapabilityStatement instance represents the capabilities of a system or piece of software, independent of a particular installation.

code.name: Requirements
code.description: The CapabilityStatement instance represents a set of requirements for other systems to meet; e.g. as part of an implementation guide or request for proposal.

codeset.name: ResourceType
codeset.description: Concrete FHIR Resource Types

codeset.name: SearchParamType
codeset.description: Data types allowed to be used for search parameters.

code.name: Number
code.description: Search parameter SHALL be a number (a whole number, or a decimal).

code.name: Date
code.description: Search parameter is on a date/time. The date format is the standard XML format, though other formats may be supported.

code.name: String
code.description: Search parameter is a simple string, like a name part. Search is case-insensitive and accent-insensitive. May match just the start of a string. String parameters may contain spaces.

code.name: Token
code.description: Search parameter on a coded element or identifier. May be used to search through the text, display, code and code/codesystem (for codes) and label, system and key (for identifier). Its value is either a string or a pair of namespace and value, separated by a "|", depending on the modifier used.

code.name: Reference
code.description: A reference to another resource (Reference or canonical).

code.name: Composite
code.description: A composite search parameter that combines a search on two values together.

code.name: Quantity
code.description: A search parameter that searches on a quantity.

code.name: Uri
code.description: A search parameter that searches on a URI (RFC 3986).

code.name: Special
code.description: Special logic applies to this parameter per the description of the search parameter.

codeset.name: RequestStatus
codeset.description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of a request.

code.name: Draft
code.description: The request has been created but is not yet complete or ready for action.

code.name: Active
code.description: The request is in force and ready to be acted upon.

code.name: OnHold
code.description: The request (and any implicit authorization to act) has been temporarily withdrawn but is expected to resume in the future.

code.name: Revoked
code.description: The request (and any implicit authorization to act) has been terminated prior to the known full completion of the intended actions. No further activity should occur.

code.name: Completed
code.description: The activity described by the request has been fully performed. No further activity will occur.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: This request should never have existed and should be considered void. (It is possible that real-world decisions were based on it. If real-world activity has occurred, the status should be "revoked" rather than "entered-in-error".).

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The authoring/source system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this request. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, but the authoring/source system does not know which.

codeset.name: FinancialResourceStatusCodes
codeset.description: This value set includes Status codes.

code.name: Active
code.description: The instance is currently in-force.

code.name: Cancelled
code.description: The instance is withdrawn, rescinded or reversed.

code.name: Draft
code.description: A new instance the contents of which is not complete.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The instance was entered in error.

codeset.name: Use
codeset.description: The purpose of the Claim: predetermination, preauthorization, claim.

code.name: Claim
code.description: The treatment is complete and this represents a Claim for the services.

code.name: Preauthorization
code.description: The treatment is proposed and this represents a Pre-authorization for the services.

code.name: Predetermination
code.description: The treatment is proposed and this represents a Pre-determination for the services.

codeset.name: ClaimProcessingCodes
codeset.description: This value set includes Claim Processing Outcome codes.

code.name: Queued
code.description: The Claim/Pre-authorization/Pre-determination has been received but processing has not begun.

code.name: Complete
code.description: The processing has completed without errors

code.name: Error
code.description: One or more errors have been detected in the Claim

code.name: Partial
code.description: No errors have been detected in the Claim and some of the adjudication has been performed.

codeset.name: EventStatus
codeset.description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of an event.

code.name: Preparation
code.description: The core event has not started yet, but some staging activities have begun (e.g. surgical suite preparation). Preparation stages may be tracked for billing purposes.

code.name: InProgress
code.description: The event is currently occurring.

code.name: NotDone
code.description: The event was terminated prior to any activity beyond preparation. I.e. The main activity has not yet begun. The boundary between preparatory and the main activity is context-specific.

code.name: OnHold
code.description: The event has been temporarily stopped but is expected to resume in the future.

code.name: Stopped
code.description: The event was terminated prior to the full completion of the intended activity but after at least some of the main activity (beyond preparation) has occurred.

code.name: Completed
code.description: The event has now concluded.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: This electronic record should never have existed, though it is possible that real-world decisions were based on it. (If real-world activity has occurred, the status should be "stopped" rather than "entered-in-error".).

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The authoring/source system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this event. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, but the authoring/source system does not know which.

codeset.name: CodeSystemContentMode
codeset.description: The extent of the content of the code system (the concepts and codes it defines) are represented in a code system resource.

code.name: NotPresent
code.description: None of the concepts defined by the code system are included in the code system resource.

code.name: Example
code.description: A subset of the valid externally defined concepts are included in the code system resource. There is no specific purpose or documented intent other than for illustrative purposes.

code.name: Fragment
code.description: A subset of the code system concepts are included in the code system resource. This is a curated subset released for a specific purpose under the governance of the code system steward, and that the intent, bounds and consequences of the fragmentation are clearly defined in the fragment or the code system documentation. Fragments are also known as partitions.

code.name: Complete
code.description: All the concepts defined by the code system are included in the code system resource.

code.name: Supplement
code.description: The resource doesnt define any new concepts; it just provides additional designations and properties to another code system.

codeset.name: FilterOperator
codeset.description: The kind of operation to perform as a part of a property based filter.

code.name: Equal
code.description: The specified property of the code equals the provided value.

code.name: IsA
code.description: Includes all concept ids that have a transitive is-a relationship with the concept Id provided as the value, including the provided concept itself (include descendant codes and self).

code.name: DescendentOf
code.description: Includes all concept ids that have a transitive is-a relationship with the concept Id provided as the value, excluding the provided concept itself (i.e. include descendant codes only).

code.name: IsNotA
code.description: The specified property of the code does not have an is-a relationship with the provided value.

code.name: Regex
code.description: The specified property of the code matches the regex specified in the provided value.

code.name: In
code.description: The specified property of the code is in the set of codes or concepts specified in the provided value (comma-separated list).

code.name: NotIn
code.description: The specified property of the code is not in the set of codes or concepts specified in the provided value (comma-separated list).

code.name: Generalizes
code.description: Includes all concept ids that have a transitive is-a relationship from the concept Id provided as the value, including the provided concept itself (i.e. include ancestor codes and self).

code.name: ChildOf
code.description: Only concepts with a direct hierarchical relationship to the index code and no other concepts. This does not include the index code in the output.

code.name: DescendentLeaf
code.description: Includes concept ids that have a transitive is-a relationship with the concept Id provided as the value, but which do not have any concept ids with transitive is-a relationships with themselves.

code.name: Exists
code.description: The specified property of the code has at least one value (if the specified value is true; if the specified value is false, then matches when the specified property of the code has no values).

codeset.name: CompartmentType
codeset.description: Which type a compartment definition describes.

code.name: Patient
code.description: The compartment definition is for the patient compartment.

code.name: Encounter
code.description: The compartment definition is for the encounter compartment.

code.name: RelatedPerson
code.description: The compartment definition is for the related-person compartment.

code.name: Practitioner
code.description: The compartment definition is for the practitioner compartment.

code.name: Device
code.description: The compartment definition is for the device compartment.

code.name: EpisodeOfCare
code.description: The compartment definition is for the episodeofcare compartment.

codeset.name: CompositionStatus
codeset.description: The workflow/clinical status of the composition.

code.name: Registered
code.description: The existence of the composition is registered, but there is nothing yet available.

code.name: Partial
code.description: This is a partial (e.g. initial, interim or preliminary) composition: data in the composition may be incomplete or unverified.

code.name: Preliminary
code.description: Verified early results are available, but not all results are final.

code.name: Final
code.description: This version of the composition is complete and verified by an appropriate person and no further work is planned. Any subsequent updates would be on a new version of the composition.

code.name: Amended
code.description: The composition content or the referenced resources have been modified (edited or added to) subsequent to being released as "final" and the composition is complete and verified by an authorized person.

code.name: Corrected
code.description: Subsequent to being final, the composition content has been modified to correct an error in the composition or referenced results.

code.name: Appended
code.description: Subsequent to being final, the composition content has been modified by adding new content. The existing content is unchanged.

code.name: Cancelled
code.description: The composition is unavailable because the measurement was not started or not completed (also sometimes called "aborted").

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: The composition or document was originally created/issued in error, and this is an amendment that marks that the entire series should not be considered as valid.

code.name: Deprecated
code.description: This composition has been withdrawn or superseded and should no longer be used.

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The authoring/source system does not know which of the status values currently applies for this observation. Note: This concept is not to be used for "other" - one of the listed statuses is presumed to apply, but the authoring/source system does not know which.

codeset.name: ConsentProvisionType
codeset.description: How a rule statement is applied, such as adding additional consent or removing consent.

code.name: Deny
code.description: Consent is denied for actions meeting these rules.

code.name: Permit
code.description: Consent is provided for actions meeting these rules.

codeset.name: ConsentDataMeaning
codeset.description: How a resource reference is interpreted when testing consent restrictions.

code.name: Instance
code.description: The consent applies directly to the instance of the resource.

code.name: Related
code.description: The consent applies directly to the instance of the resource and instances it refers to.

code.name: Dependents
code.description: The consent applies directly to the instance of the resource and instances that refer to it.

code.name: Authoredby
code.description: The consent applies to instances of resources that are authored by.

codeset.name: DeviceNameType
codeset.description: The type of name the device is referred by.

code.name: RegisteredName
code.description: The term assigned to a medical device by the entity who registers or submits information about it to a jurisdiction or its databases. This may be considered the manufacturer assigned name (e.g., brand name assigned by the labeler or manufacturer in US, or device name assigned by the manufacturer in EU) and may also be synonymous with proprietary name or trade name of the device.

code.name: UserFriendlyName
code.description: The term that generically describes the device by a name as assigned by the manufacturer that is recognized by lay person. This common or generic name may be printed on the package it came in or some combination of that name with the model number, serial number, or other attribute that makes the name easy to understand for the user of that device. It is often exposed in communicating devices transport protocols. It is provided to help users identify the device when reported in discovery operations.

code.name: PatientReportedName
code.description: the term used by the patient associated with the device when describing the device, for example knee implant, when documented as a self-reported device.

codeset.name: DocumentReferenceStatus
codeset.description: The status of the document reference.

code.name: Current
code.description: This is the current reference for this document.

code.name: Superseded
code.description: This reference has been superseded by another reference.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: This reference was created in error.

codeset.name: EncounterStatus
codeset.description: Current state of the encounter.

code.name: Planned
code.description: The Encounter has not yet started.

code.name: InProgress
code.description: The Encounter has begun and the patient is present / the practitioner and the patient are meeting.

code.name: OnHold
code.description: The Encounter has begun, but is currently on hold, e.g. because the patient is temporarily on leave.

code.name: Discharged
code.description: The Encounter has been clinically completed, the patient has been discharged from the facility or the visit has ended, and the patient may have departed (refer to subjectStatus). While the encounter is in this status, administrative activities are usually performed, collating all required documentation and charge information before being released for billing, at which point the status will move to completed.

code.name: Completed
code.description: The Encounter has ended.

code.name: Cancelled
code.description: The Encounter has ended before it has begun.

code.name: Discontinued
code.description: The Encounter has started, but was not able to be completed. Further action may need to be performed, such as rescheduling appointments related to this encounter.

code.name: EnteredInError
code.description: This instance should not have been part of this patients medical record.

code.name: Unknown
code.description: The encounter status is unknown. Note that "unknown" is a value of last resort and every attempt should be made to provide a meaningful value other than "unknown".

codeset.name: EvidenceVariableHandling
codeset.description: The handling of the variable in statistical analysis for exposures or outcomes (E.g. Dichotomous, Continuous, Descriptive).

code.name: Continuous
code.description: A continuous variable is one for which, within the limits the variable ranges, any value is possible (from STATO http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000251).

code.name: Dichotomous
code.description: A dichotomous variable is a categorical variable which is defined to have only 2 categories or possible values (from STATO http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000090).

code.name: Ordinal
code.description: An ordinal variable is a categorical variable where the discrete possible values are ordered or correspond to an implicit ranking (from STATO http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000228).

code.name: Polychotomous
code.description: A polychotomous variable is a categorical variable which is defined to have minimally 2 categories or possible values. (from STATO http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000087). Suggestion to limit code use to situations when neither dichotomous nor ordinal variables apply.

codeset.name: ListMode
codeset.description: The processing mode that applies to this list.

code.name: Working
code.description: This list is the master list, maintained in an ongoing fashion with regular updates as the real-world list it is tracking changes.

code.name: Snapshot
code.description: This list was prepared as a snapshot. It should not be assumed to be current.

code.name: Changes
code.description: A point-in-time list that shows what changes have been made or recommended. E.g. a discharge medication list showing what was added and removed during an encounter.

codeset.name: VersionIndependentResourceTypesAll
codeset.description: Current and past FHIR resource types (deleted or renamed), including abstract types

codeset.name: CommonLanguages
codeset.description: This value set includes common codes from BCP-47 (see http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47)

codeset.name: FHIRTypes
codeset.description: All FHIR types

code.name: Base
code.description: Base Type: Base definition for all types defined in FHIR type system.

code.name: Element
code.description: Element Type: Base definition for all elements in a resource.

code.name: BackboneElement
code.description: BackboneElement Type: Base definition for all elements that are defined inside a resource - but not those in a data type.

code.name: DataType
code.description: DataType Type: The base class for all re-useable types defined as part of the FHIR Specification.

code.name: Address
code.description: Address Type: An address expressed using postal conventions (as opposed to GPS or other location definition formats). This data type may be used to convey addresses for use in delivering mail as well as for visiting locations which might not be valid for mail delivery. There are a variety of postal address formats defined around the world.The ISO21090-codedString may be used to provide a coded representation of the contents of strings in an Address.

code.name: Annotation
code.description: Annotation Type: A text note which also contains information about who made the statement and when.

code.name: Attachment
code.description: Attachment Type: For referring to data content defined in other formats.

code.name: Availability
code.description: Availability Type: Availability data for an {item}.

code.name: BackboneType
code.description: BackboneType Type: Base definition for the few data types that are allowed to carry modifier extensions.

code.name: Dosage
code.description: Dosage Type: Indicates how the medication is/was taken or should be taken by the patient.

code.name: ElementDefinition
code.description: ElementDefinition Type: Captures constraints on each element within the resource, profile, or extension.

code.name: MarketingStatus
code.description: MarketingStatus Type: The marketing status describes the date when a medicinal product is actually put on the market or the date as of which it is no longer available.

code.name: ProductShelfLife
code.description: ProductShelfLife Type: The shelf-life and storage information for a medicinal product item or container can be described using this class.

code.name: Timing
code.description: Timing Type: Specifies an event that may occur multiple times. Timing schedules are used to record when things are planned, expected or requested to occur. The most common usage is in dosage instructions for medications. They are also used when planning care of various kinds, and may be used for reporting the schedule to which past regular activities were carried out.

code.name: CodeableConcept
code.description: CodeableConcept Type: A concept that may be defined by a formal reference to a terminology or ontology or may be provided by text.

code.name: CodeableReference
code.description: CodeableReference Type: A reference to a resource (by instance), or instead, a reference to a concept defined in a terminology or ontology (by class).

code.name: Coding
code.description: Coding Type: A reference to a code defined by a terminology system.

code.name: ContactDetail
code.description: ContactDetail Type: Specifies contact information for a person or organization.

code.name: ContactPoint
code.description: ContactPoint Type: Details for all kinds of technology mediated contact points for a person or organization, including telephone, email, etc.

code.name: Contributor
code.description: Contributor Type: A contributor to the content of a knowledge asset, including authors, editors, reviewers, and endorsers.

code.name: DataRequirement
code.description: DataRequirement Type: Describes a required data item for evaluation in terms of the type of data, and optional code or date-based filters of the data.

code.name: Expression
code.description: Expression Type: A expression that is evaluated in a specified context and returns a value. The context of use of the expression must specify the context in which the expression is evaluated, and how the result of the expression is used.

code.name: ExtendedContactDetail
code.description: ExtendedContactDetail Type: Specifies contact information for a specific purpose over a period of time, might be handled/monitored by a specific named person or organization.

code.name: Extension
code.description: Extension Type: Optional Extension Element - found in all resources.

code.name: HumanName
code.description: HumanName Type: A name, normally of a human, that can be used for other living entities (e.g. animals but not organizations) that have been assigned names by a human and may need the use of name parts or the need for usage information.

code.name: Identifier
code.description: Identifier Type: An identifier - identifies some entity uniquely and unambiguously. Typically this is used for business identifiers.

code.name: Meta
code.description: Meta Type: The metadata about a resource. This is content in the resource that is maintained by the infrastructure. Changes to the content might not always be associated with version changes to the resource.

code.name: MonetaryComponent
code.description: MonetaryComponent Type: Availability data for an {item}.

code.name: Money
code.description: Money Type: An amount of economic utility in some recognized currency.

code.name: Narrative
code.description: Narrative Type: A human-readable summary of the resource conveying the essential clinical and business information for the resource.

code.name: ParameterDefinition
code.description: ParameterDefinition Type: The parameters to the module. This collection specifies both the input and output parameters. Input parameters are provided by the caller as part of the $evaluate operation. Output parameters are included in the GuidanceResponse.

code.name: Period
code.description: Period Type: A time period defined by a start and end date and optionally time.

code.name: PrimitiveType
code.description: PrimitiveType Type: The base type for all re-useable types defined that have a simple property.

code.name: Base64Binary
code.description: base64Binary Type: A stream of bytes

code.name: Boolean
code.description: boolean Type: Value of "true" or "false"

code.name: Date
code.description: date Type: A date or partial date (e.g. just year or year + month). There is no UTC offset. The format is a union of the schema types gYear, gYearMonth and date. Dates SHALL be valid dates.

code.name: DateTime
code.description: dateTime Type: A date, date-time or partial date (e.g. just year or year + month). If hours and minutes are specified, a UTC offset SHALL be populated. The format is a union of the schema types gYear, gYearMonth, date and dateTime. Seconds must be provided due to schema type constraints but may be zero-filled and may be ignored. Dates SHALL be valid dates.

code.name: Decimal
code.description: decimal Type: A rational number with implicit precision

code.name: Instant
code.description: instant Type: An instant in time - known at least to the second

code.name: Integer
code.description: integer Type: A whole number

code.name: PositiveInt
code.description: positiveInt type: An integer with a value that is positive (e.g. >0)

code.name: UnsignedInt
code.description: unsignedInt type: An integer with a value that is not negative (e.g. >= 0)

code.name: Integer64
code.description: integer64 Type: A very large whole number

code.name: String
code.description: string Type: A sequence of Unicode characters

code.name: Code
code.description: code type: A string which has at least one character and no leading or trailing whitespace and where there is no whitespace other than single spaces in the contents

code.name: Id
code.description: id type: Any combination of letters, numerals, "-" and ".", with a length limit of 64 characters. (This might be an integer, an unprefixed OID, UUID or any other identifier pattern that meets these constraints.) Ids are case-insensitive.

code.name: Markdown
code.description: markdown type: A string that may contain Github Flavored Markdown syntax for optional processing by a mark down presentation engine

code.name: Time
code.description: time Type: A time during the day, with no date specified

code.name: Uri
code.description: uri Type: String of characters used to identify a name or a resource

code.name: Canonical
code.description: canonical type: A URI that is a reference to a canonical URL on a FHIR resource

code.name: Oid
code.description: oid type: An OID represented as a URI

code.name: Url
code.description: url type: A URI that is a literal reference

code.name: Uuid
code.description: uuid type: A UUID, represented as a URI

code.name: Quantity
code.description: Quantity Type: A measured amount (or an amount that can potentially be measured). Note that measured amounts include amounts that are not precisely quantified, including amounts involving arbitrary units and floating currencies.

code.name: Age
code.description: Age Type: A duration of time during which an organism (or a process) has existed.

code.name: Count
code.description: Count Type: A measured amount (or an amount that can potentially be measured). Note that measured amounts include amounts that are not precisely quantified, including amounts involving arbitrary units and floating currencies.

code.name: Distance
code.description: Distance Type: A length - a value with a unit that is a physical distance.

code.name: Duration
code.description: Duration Type: A length of time.

code.name: Range
code.description: Range Type: A set of ordered Quantities defined by a low and high limit.

code.name: Ratio
code.description: Ratio Type: A relationship of two Quantity values - expressed as a numerator and a denominator.

code.name: RatioRange
code.description: RatioRange Type: A range of ratios expressed as a low and high numerator and a denominator.

code.name: Reference
code.description: Reference Type: A reference from one resource to another.

code.name: RelatedArtifact
code.description: RelatedArtifact Type: Related artifacts such as additional documentation, justification, or bibliographic references.

code.name: SampledData
code.description: SampledData Type: A series of measurements taken by a device, with upper and lower limits. There may be more than one dimension in the data.

code.name: Signature
code.description: Signature Type: A signature along with supporting context. The signature may be a digital signature that is cryptographic in nature, or some other signature acceptable to the domain. This other signature may be as simple as a graphical image representing a hand-written signature, or a signature ceremony Different signature approaches have different utilities.

code.name: TriggerDefinition
code.description: TriggerDefinition Type: A description of a triggering event. Triggering events can be named events, data events, or periodic, as determined by the type element.

code.name: UsageContext
code.description: UsageContext Type: Specifies clinical/business/etc. metadata that can be used to retrieve, index and/or categorize an artifact. This metadata can either be specific to the applicable population (e.g., age category, DRG) or the specific context of care (e.g., venue, care setting, provider of care).

code.name: VirtualServiceDetail
code.description: VirtualServiceDetail Type: Virtual Service Contact Details.

code.name: Xhtml
code.description: xhtml Type definition

code.name: Resource
code.description: This is the base resource type for everything.

code.name: Binary
code.description: A resource that represents the data of a single raw artifact as digital content accessible in its native format. A Binary resource can contain any content, whether text, image, pdf, zip archive, etc.

code.name: Bundle
code.description: A container for a collection of resources.

code.name: DomainResource
code.description: A resource that includes narrative, extensions, and contained resources.

code.name: Account
code.description: A financial tool for tracking value accrued for a particular purpose. In the healthcare field, used to track charges for a patient, cost centers, etc.

code.name: ActivityDefinition
code.description: This resource allows for the definition of some activity to be performed, independent of a particular patient, practitioner, or other performance context.

code.name: ActorDefinition
code.description: The ActorDefinition resource is used to describe an actor - a human or an application that plays a role in data exchange, and that may have obligations associated with the role the actor plays.

code.name: AdministrableProductDefinition
code.description: A medicinal product in the final form which is suitable for administering to a patient (after any mixing of multiple components, dissolution etc. has been performed).

code.name: AdverseEvent
code.description: An event (i.e. any change to current patient status) that may be related to unintended effects on a patient or research participant. The unintended effects may require additional monitoring, treatment, hospitalization, or may result in death. The AdverseEvent resource also extends to potential or avoided events that could have had such effects. There are two major domains where the AdverseEvent resource is expected to be used. One is in clinical care reported adverse events and the other is in reporting adverse events in clinical research trial management. Adverse events can be reported by healthcare providers, patients, caregivers or by medical products manufacturers. Given the differences between these two concepts, we recommend consulting the domain specific implementation guides when implementing the AdverseEvent Resource. The implementation guides include specific extensions, value sets and constraints.

code.name: AllergyIntolerance
code.description: Risk of harmful or undesirable, physiological response which is unique to an individual and associated with exposure to a substance.

code.name: Appointment
code.description: A booking of a healthcare event among patient(s), practitioner(s), related person(s) and/or device(s) for a specific date/time. This may result in one or more Encounter(s).

code.name: AppointmentResponse
code.description: A reply to an appointment request for a patient and/or practitioner(s), such as a confirmation or rejection.

code.name: ArtifactAssessment
code.description: This Resource provides one or more comments, classifiers or ratings about a Resource and supports attribution and rights management metadata for the added content.

code.name: AuditEvent
code.description: A record of an event relevant for purposes such as operations, privacy, security, maintenance, and performance analysis.

code.name: Basic
code.description: Basic is used for handling concepts not yet defined in FHIR, narrative-only resources that dont map to an existing resource, and custom resources not appropriate for inclusion in the FHIR specification.

code.name: BiologicallyDerivedProduct
code.description: A biological material originating from a biological entity intended to be transplanted or infused into another (possibly the same) biological entity.

code.name: BiologicallyDerivedProductDispense
code.description: A record of dispensation of a biologically derived product.

code.name: BodyStructure
code.description: Record details about an anatomical structure. This resource may be used when a coded concept does not provide the necessary detail needed for the use case.

code.name: CanonicalResource
code.description: Common Interface declaration for conformance and knowledge artifact resources.

code.name: CapabilityStatement
code.description: A Capability Statement documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of a FHIR Server or Client for a particular version of FHIR that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server implementation.

code.name: CarePlan
code.description: Describes the intention of how one or more practitioners intend to deliver care for a particular patient, group or community for a period of time, possibly limited to care for a specific condition or set of conditions.

code.name: CareTeam
code.description: The Care Team includes all the people and organizations who plan to participate in the coordination and delivery of care.

code.name: ChargeItem
code.description: The resource ChargeItem describes the provision of healthcare provider products for a certain patient, therefore referring not only to the product, but containing in addition details of the provision, like date, time, amounts and participating organizations and persons. Main Usage of the ChargeItem is to enable the billing process and internal cost allocation.

code.name: ChargeItemDefinition
code.description: The ChargeItemDefinition resource provides the properties that apply to the (billing) codes necessary to calculate costs and prices. The properties may differ largely depending on type and realm, therefore this resource gives only a rough structure and requires profiling for each type of billing code system.

code.name: Citation
code.description: The Citation Resource enables reference to any knowledge artifact for purposes of identification and attribution. The Citation Resource supports existing reference structures and developing publication practices such as versioning, expressing complex contributorship roles, and referencing computable resources.

code.name: Claim
code.description: A provider issued list of professional services and products which have been provided, or are to be provided, to a patient which is sent to an insurer for reimbursement.

code.name: ClaimResponse
code.description: This resource provides the adjudication details from the processing of a Claim resource.

code.name: ClinicalImpression
